title: Alpha Plasma Microwave Modeler
description:
WHO WE ARE

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.

WHY JOIN PROXIMA FUSION

  • You will get to work on some of the most complex tech challenges to bring abundant, safe, clean energy to the world.

  • You'll get to join and learn from an exceptional selection of accomplished and driven individuals.

  • Do your life’s best work and enjoy the journey.

  • Get to show that big things are possible in Europe when you assemble the best talent.

YOUR IMPACT
As the Alpha Plasma Microwave Modeler, you will own the physics simulation pipeline that connects our gyrotron sources to plasma performance. You will model the propagation, polarization, and absorption of millimeter waves in the Alpha stellarator guiding the design choices that determine how effectively we heat the plasma.
You will sit at the interface between plasma physics, RF engineering, and systems design, working closely with the ECRH design lead, electromagnetic engineers, and academic partners to ensure that simulation insight drives hardware decisions.
You will establish the simulation baseline by running ray-tracing and beam-tracing codes across the Alpha operating space, validating these against W7-X experimental data so that the results can drive the design of the Alpha ECRH launcher and gyrotron designs.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Run ray-tracing and beam-tracing simulations of EC wave propagation and absorption using codes such as TRAVIS, RAYTRAX and more complex beam or full wave model codes

  • Develop an integrated modeling framework that couples wave deposition to transport codes, enabling temperature and density profile optimization and validation of the heating scenario performance

  • Build and maintain Python-based post-processing pipelines to automate scenario scanning and interface simulation outputs with the Alpha integrated design framework

  • Model Electron Cyclotron Current Drive (ECCD) and assess its ability to modify rotational transform and equilibrium in the Alpha quasi-isodynamic configuration

  • Contribute to design reviews, interface control documents, and technical reports to ensure simulation results are traceable and actionable

WHO YOU ARE

  • PhD (or equivalent demonstrated expertise) in plasma physics, applied physics, or a related field, with a focus on plasma-wave interactions or RF heating of magnetically confined plasmas

  • Hands-on experience with at least one EC propagation or absorption code (TRAVIS, TORBEAM, C3PO, IPF-FD3D, or similar)

  • Proficiency in Python for simulation scripting, data analysis, and visualization; comfort reading and modifying legacy Fortran or C/C++ code

  • Systems-thinking mindset: able to translate physics outputs into engineering requirements and hardware constraints

  • Strong team player, comfortable working across physics and engineering disciplines and with external academic partners

INTERVIEW PROCESS

  • Recruiter Interview (30-60 min)

  • Technical Screening (30 min)

  • Technical Panel (3x60 min)


*This role sits at Level 2 of our framework, please inquire during the recruitment process for further information.

At Proxima Fusion, our mission is bold: making limitless clean energy a reality. To get there, we need a high-performing, diverse team that brings different perspectives, challenges assumptions, and builds together with purpose. We know that diversity of thought and experience leads to better ideas, stronger execution, and a more resilient team. We don’t look at how you identify, what you look like, who you choose to worship or what ethnicity you are. We care about what you can bring to the table.

Raytheon brings the strength of more than 100 years of experience and renowned engineering expertise to meet the needs of today’s mission and stay ahead of tomorrow’s threat. We deliver solutions that help our nation and allies defend freedoms and deter aggression, creating a safer, more secure world. Join us and help shape the future of aerospace and defense.

The Hardware Design Integrity (HWDI) department enables program execution quality and on-time delivery by ensuring integrity, compliance, security and process efficiency of our technical data, designs and systems. HWDI is part of the Product Integrity center, alongside Configuration and Data Management (CMDM).

The Design Integrity team is looking for a Principal Specialist Design Integrity Checker.

This position will be onsite in Tucson, Arizona.

What You Will Do

(Please note they are flexible for people with a mechanical engineering or electrical engineering background but must meet the must have qualifications for one)

Mechanical Design Checker:

  • Perform design verification and validation of traditional Mechanical 2D Drawings as well as “Model-Based” Design TDPs.
  • Ensure that mechanical design documentation and models consist of both complex and simple machined parts, castings, and other fabricated items.
  • Ensure that mechanical design drawings, documentation, and associated electronic data output files used for production and / or procurement will undergo a comprehensive verification and validation review for design producibility and data integrity, quality, and consistency.
  • Confirm that mechanical traditional and Model Based Designs are checked for form, fit, and function to program unique requirements while conforming to specific Company and Industry Specifications & Standards.
  • Confirm that the synchronization of design representation (drawings) with the design database models from which they were derived, is authenticated.
  • Overall, ensuring that the design verification and validation follows ASME Y14.41 and MIL-STD-31000 standards.

OR

Electrical Design Checker:

  • Providing a formal, systematic, design verification and validation of traditional Electrical 2D TDPs.
  • Electrical TDPs will encompass the circuit card assembly (or flexible circuit assembly), printed wiring board, and schematic design representation (drawings); including electronic Bills of Material (eBOMs), and design models developed using computer aided design tools.
  • Applications that will be used for Electrical Checks: EXPEDITION-DxDESIGNER (Extract latest Schematic), BLUEPRINT (Extract latest CCA and PWB), VALOR (PWB – Dims, Holes for Board Layer StackUp), and EXCEL for eBOM and other electrical change comparison software.
  • Electrical Model-Based Engineering (MBE) concepts and electronic Bills of Material (eBOMs) experience.
  • Support reviews of Software documents per Program Requirements.
  • Perform design verification and validation of traditional 2D Drawings as well as “Model-Based” Design TDPs.
  • Confirm that the synchronization of design representation (drawings) with the design database models from which they were derived, is authenticated.
  • Overall, ensuring that the design verification and validation is in compliance with ASME Y14.41 and MIL-STD-31000 standards.
  • The selected candidate may (with training) also be responsible for verification and validation of the opposing design TDP mentioned above.

Qualifications You Must Have

  • Typically requires a Bachelor’s of Science, Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics (STEM) and 5 years of prior relevant experience OR an Advanced degree in a related field and a minimum of 3 years of experience OR In absence of a degree, 9 years of relevant experience is required.
  • Active and transferable U.S. government issued security clearance is required prior to start date.
  • 5 years of experience designing, drafting, and/or verifying / validating detailed Technical Data Packages (TDPs).
  • Experience with Computer Aided Design (CAD) design / drafting.
  • Must have experience in one of these two areas with required skills.
    • For Mechanical Design Checker: Experience with at least one of the following: PTC Creo Suite, Creo / ProE, SolidWorks, AutoCAD, Raster, Canvas, GTXImage, and/or Myriad.
    • For Electrical Design Checker: Experience with Electrical software packages, i.e. Mentor Boardstation, EXPEDITION-DxDESIGNER, or related.


Qualifications We Prefer

  • Experience with Industry Model-Based Engineering (MBE) experience (3D PDF design representation), and ASME, Military & Industry Standards.
  • Configuration & Data Management (CM / DM) comprehension and aptitude to develop advanced TDP record set management techniques in PDM.
  • Ability to collaborate with various engineering disciplines and leadership levels, and negotiate critical discussions for solutions that meet program needs to align with design / drafting requirements.
  • (Multi-disciplined support potential) Electrical Computer Aided Design (CAD) design / drafting experience; MentorGraphics design applications (DxDesigner, Valor), DownStream Technologies (BluePrint-PCB), and other electrical change comparison software, Electrical Model-Based Engineering (MBE) concepts and electronic Bills of Material (eBOMs) experience.
  • Problem solving and process development / improvement capability, and the ability to grasp and ultimately adapt to continuously evolving technologies, processes, procedures, and best practices.
  • (Multi-disciplined support potential) Mechanical Computer Aided Design (CAD) design / drafting experience; Creo/ProE design applications and other mechanical drafting applications.

What We Offer

Some of the benefits we offer include parental (including paternal) leave, flexible work schedules, achievement awards, educational assistance and child/adult backup care.

title: Senior Network Engineer
description:
Company Description

We’re . You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day.


We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers.

Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale.

If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact.

With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.

We are a fast-growing global FinTech company, operating across multiple regions with a footprint spanning trading floors, data centres, and corporate offices worldwide. As a Senior Network Engineer, you will own the design, delivery and ongoing optimisation of our corporate office network infrastructure globally. You will define the standards that govern how office networks are built, ensure consistent deployment across locations, and deliver reliable, secure connectivity that supports modern workplace technologies and collaboration tools.

This is a hands-on, high-impact role. You'll be the subject matter expert who turns business requirements into reliable, secure, and scalable network solutions, from greenfield office buildouts to major refits of existing sites.

Network Design & Standards

  • Define and maintain global network architecture standards for corporate office environments, covering LAN, WAN, Wi-Fi and SD-WAN, ensuring consistent and repeatable deployments across all locations.

  • Develop and maintain network build standards, configuration templates, and technical runbooks

  • Ensure all designs meet FinTech regulatory and security requirements (e.g., PCI-DSS, SOC2)

  • Own the reference architecture and standard design patterns used for new office deployments and office expansions.

Operations, Monitoring & User Experience

  • Provide escalation support (L3/L4) for network incidents across all office locations, leading root cause analysis and driving permanent fixes

  • Own end-to-end network observability across all office environments, including monitoring, telemetry, packet loss, bandwidth utilisation and device health. Ensure Wi-Fi and network performance delivers a high-quality employee experience across all office locations.

  • Define and track network SLAs and KPIs for office environments, with regular reporting to IT leadership

  • Champion a user-first approach to network performance, proactively identifying and resolving degradation before it generates tickets

  • Work closely with IT Engineering and AV teams to ensure a seamless connectivity experience for meeting rooms, collaboration tools, and hybrid working

  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives based on monitoring data, user feedback, and post-incident reviews

Office Buildouts & Refits

  • Lead end-to-end network delivery for new office openings and major refits globally from initial scoping and design through to commissioning and handover

  • Engage and manage third-party vendors, cabling contractors, and ISPs to ensure on-time, on-budget delivery

  • Conduct site surveys and produce detailed network designs, rack layouts, and cabling schematics

  • Ensure all office network deployments adhere to global architecture standards and security requirements.

  • Produce high- and low-level network design documentation for office network deployments.

Stakeholder & Project Management

  • Partner with Real Estate, Workplace, GTSO Teams and senior IT leadership to plan and scope network requirements for new and changing office locations

  • Produce clear technical documentation and present designs to both technical and non-technical stakeholders

  • Manage project timelines, risks, and dependencies across concurrent office programmes

Required Skills & Experience

  • 8+ years of hands-on network engineering experience, with a strong focus on corporate office environments

  • Expertise in Cisco and/or Juniper switching and routing (BGP, OSPF, VLAN design, QoS)

  • Solid experience with enterprise Wi-Fi platforms (Cisco Meraki, Aruba, or equivalent)

  • Proven track record delivering network buildouts or major refits in a corporate or financial services environment

  • Experience with SD-WAN technologies (Meraki, Fortinet or similar)

  • Strong understanding of network security principles: firewalls, network segmentation, 802.1X

  • Familiarity with MPLS, VPLS, and internet circuit procurement

  • Experience working with third-party vendors and ISPs across multiple geographies

  • Comfortable working in a regulated environment (PCI-DSS, SOC2 awareness is a plus)

Desirable

  • CCNP / CCIE (Routing & Switching)

  • Fortinet NSE 4-7 (Network Security)

  • Exposure to network automation tooling (Ansible, Python, NetBox)

  • Experience with ITSM platforms (Jira Service Management, ServiceNow or similar)

  • Experience with network monitoring tools (LogicMonitor, SolarWinds, Elasticsearch, Grafana, Splunk or Datadog)

  • Familiarity with data centre networking concepts and their integration with corporate office networks.

Additional Information

Bring all of you to work

We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one.

Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands.

We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here.

It’s important we set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter directly, if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable.

Life at

We understand that work is just one part of your life. Our hybrid working model offers flexibility, with three days per week in the office to support collaboration and connection.

Curious about what it’s like to be part of our team? Visit our Careers Page to learn more about our culture, open roles, and what drives us.

For a closer look at daily life at , follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram

title: Senior Product Designer
description:
At Moss, we give finance professionals the power to automate their day-to-day and make forward-thinking decisions.

Our team and culture make us unique — we’re driven by impact and growth, where every one of us strives to learn and excel. Recognised by Sifted’s Rising 100 and LinkedIn's Top Startups, we’re here to help propel your career and together, make Moss a lasting success.

As a Senior Product Designer at Moss, you'll play a key role in defining how finance teams automate their work with the help of agents. This is an exciting time to join and help shape both what and how we solve for our customers' needs with AI.

You'll join an experienced team of 8 product designers based across Berlin, London, Amsterdam, and Warsaw. Curiosity, empathy, and craft are at the core of how we design product at Moss. The team is AI-forward and values growth and learning as much as shipping the best possible experiences for our customers. Moss values design as a strategic lever for growth and customer satisfaction, on par with product and engineering at every stage.

We’re looking for multiple product designers to join us and shape the future of finance and accounting work, as well as the new ways we design that future.

What you’ll do

  • Design Moss’ next generation of accounting products where agents and finance professionals work together, ensuring accuracy and trust throughout.

  • Build deep understanding of your problem space alongside peers from product management, engineering, and finance experts. Identify and solve for opportunities that drive Moss' growth across our target markets (Germany, UK, Netherlands).

  • Build with AI to make customer-ready demos the default design artifact, moving fluidly between code and canvas throughout the process.

  • Continuously test assumptions with customers, grounding an iterative design process in understanding of finance professionals' needs.

  • Inspire your team to go the extra mile, taking solutions from useful to delightful.

  • Raise the quality bar for yourself and the design team through jams and crits. Share learnings and contribute to our evolving design context, including our component and skill libraries.

About you

  • Experience designing complex products end-to-end, in close collaboration with product and engineering leads.

  • A portfolio that demonstrates product thinking and customer centricity as much as visually strong work.

  • Evaluative research practice spanning planning through synthesis.

  • Demonstrated use of AI in your workflow, and passion for experimenting with the latest tools and workflows.

  • Clear communication. The ability to confidently present and articulate your ideas, and bring cross-functional peers along with strong rationale.

  • Team player. A collaborative, empowering way of working.

In addition, here are the skills and attributes we are looking for:

  • Expert Crafter: You are the expert in maintaining design quality, ensuring every solution is both intuitive and simple, pushing for excellence in both visual design and user experience while leveraging the design system as much as possible.

  • Velocity Driver: You move quickly and strategically. You make smart, informed decisions to prioritize the most impactful work and move work forward by delivering high-quality designs that balance speed and thoughtfulness.

  • Customer Champion: You deeply understand the mindset and motivations of our users, designing with empathy and anticipating needs before they arise. You translate these insights into intuitive, user-centered solutions.

  • Visionary Strategist: You craft design strategies that balance long-term vision with short-term impact. Your designs not only solve today’s challenges but set the foundation for future scalability and growth.

  • Growth-Driven Innovator: You actively seek and give constructive feedback, always evolving your skill set and mindset. You embrace challenges, leave ego at the door, and focus on continuous improvement for yourself and the team.

About Moss

Moss is a SaaS scale-up founded in Berlin, with a team of 300+ people from 50+ nationalities in 5 offices across Europe.

Our ambition is bold: to power every SMB’s spend across Europe - fully digital, AI-driven, and seamlessly integrated for complete control. To date, over 5000 businesses in Germany, Netherlands and the UK use Moss’ leading spend management product, with modules such as corporate cards, accounts payables, employee cash reimbursements and procurement.

Moss has raised a total of €180 million in funding and is backed by the most renowned tech investors including Valar Ventures, Tiger Global, Global Founders Capital, Cherry Ventures and A-Star.

Be part of a culture that thrives on impact and speed, where you can take bold moves, learn fast and accomplish more. We’re a place where you can fast track your career - here's what else to expect:

  • Top-of-market compensation package, including equity.

  • Our vibrant offices are at the heart of our culture, where in-person time fuels collaboration and connection over weekly breakfasts and Friday demos.

  • Additional benefits include: 20 days “work from abroad”, 600EUR/GBP Learning & Development Budget, and other local benefits.

Unless stated otherwise, benefits apply to full-time positions (interns and working students receive a tailored package).

By applying for the above position, you will confirm that you have reviewed and agreed to our Data Privacy Policy.

title: Senior Product Engineer (Frontend) - NYC
description:
About Sequence

About Sequence: If you join Sequence, you'll help build the platform that lets companies get paid - weâ€™re already processing $1bn+ in annual invoice volume and growing fast. We're building the AI-powered revenue platform for modern finance teams, replacing fragile spreadsheets and legacy systems with software their teams love using. Cognition, incident.io, MoonPay, and 100+ other high-growth companies trust us to handle their entire revenue cycle across quoting, billing, and revenue recognition. Founded by repeat entrepreneurs, we hit 10x ARR growth last year and just closed a $20M Series A led by 645 Ventures, alongside a16z and exceptional founders and CFOs from companies like Decagon, Klaviyo and Wise.

What itâ€™s like to work at Sequence? Small team, big opportunity, real ownership. You'll do work that matters, have direct access to customers, and grow alongside the company. If you want to do the best work of your career at a company that's scaling fast, we'd love to meet you.

What You'll Be Doing

We care deeply about the quality of the product we're building. We're looking for engineers who are ambitious and take ownership end-to-end: from identifying what to build, through shipping, to making sure it works for real customers.

Hereâ€™s what you might work on:

  • AI-powered workflows. Our customers spend hours on repetitive busywork - chasing approvals, sending payment reminders, routing exceptions. You'll build flexible systems that customers configure in natural language - "require VP approval for deals over $100k with annual terms" - and that needs to translate into something they can understand, trust, and debug.
  • Human-in-the-loop systems. Automation only gets you so far. You'll build the interfaces that bring the right people in at the right time, with the right context: approval chains that flex to each company's rules, escalation flows that surface what matters, and dashboards that make complex workflows legible at a glance. It requires the obsessive attention to detail that makes our customers genuinely love using the product.

We're a lean team growing to 20+ engineers. You'll have real influence on what we build and how we build it. Early enough to shape fundamental architecture. Late enough that customers depend on what you ship.

What Our Newest Hires Have Shipped

Watchtower: our command center for AI agents. As we introduce agents that automate financial workflows, customers need visibility and control. This included building our first agent - a contract intake system that extracts customer and pricing information from uploaded or emailed contracts, taking customers from signed contract to automated billing in minutes.

A fully integrated e-signature experience for quotes. When a customer is closing a deal, friction kills momentum. We rebuilt the signing experience - including embedded authentication and branded emails - into a seamless signing experience used by teams at the top tech companies every day.

Role-based access controls across the product. Different companies have different structures, but they all need tight control over who can approve deals or access sensitive data. This meant designing a flexible RBAC model that handles resources across surfaces.

See more of what weâ€™ve shipped in our public changelog.

You should apply if

You're a builder who wants to solve problems end-to-end:

  • You've built and shipped high quality web apps in product-lead businesses
  • You have experience with modern front-end development (e.g., React, Typescript)
  • You have a keen attention to visual detail and can faithfully bring UX to life
  • You care about customers - you want to understand why you're building something, not just what
  • Youâ€™re comfortable with ambiguity. You thrive in early ideation stages, share work-in-progress to gather feedback, and adapt easily based on input
  • You communicate clearly. Thoughtful communication is a superpower that sharpens how we collaborate and build

This might not be right for you

We're a small team moving fast on hard problems. That might not be a fit if you:

  • Enjoy larger organisation structures and staying only within your area of expertise. Taking ownership here means doing whatever the problem needs
  • Want a traditional engineering team set up, with a predictable roadmap and clearly scoped out tickets provided for you
  • Prefer a slower pace. Customers are depending on what we ship
  • Aren't comfortable with production responsibility. We're revenue-critical infrastructure - on-call matters here

Tech stack

We hire for ability, not a specific tech stack. Hereâ€™s what we use:

  • Frontend: TypeScript, React, Tanstack Query, Jotai, Playwright
  • Backend: Kotlin, Postgres, BigQuery
  • Infrastructure: Google Cloud, Vercel, Terraform
  • Monitoring: Google Cloud Monitoring, Sentry, PostHog
  • Tools: GitHub, Slack, Notion, Linear

Read our engineering principles

How We Work

Weâ€™re based in London and New York and love spending as much time with our colleagues as possible. We spend three days together in the office, with team lunch on Wednesdays.

You'll join a cross-functional product team working directly with design and product. We get together twice a year for company offsites.

title: Senior Cloud Security Engineer
description:
Company Description

We’re . You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day.


We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers.

Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale.

With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.

The role

You will evolve 's security posture across our multi-cloud environments and SIEM platform. This role sits at the intersection of cloud security engineering and detection capability — responsible for both hardening the infrastructure we operate on and ensuring we can see what's happening across it.

You will lead security integration projects, guide cloud engineering teams, and drive continuous improvement across monitoring and detection, including applying AI to accelerate security operations.

This is not a tool-monitoring role. You are here to architect secure cloud environments, build and enhance detection logic at scale, and drive measurable improvements to our security baseline across AWS, Azure, and GCP.

You will partner closely with Engineering, GRC, Technology Risk and Security Operations - defining standards, fine tuning the SIEM, and progressively taking on the most complex cloud security and detection engineering challenges across the organisation.

What you’ll be responsible for


Cloud Security

  • Secure and continuously improve our multi-cloud estate (AWS, Azure, GCP) using cloud native tooling to keep our cloud infrastructure hardened and compliant

  • Partner with Engineering and Security Operation team to make security a natural part of how we design and deliver, automating compliance checks so security scales without friction

  • Defining and enforcing cloud security architecture standards, guardrails, and policy-as-code inline with industry best practices including NIST, CIS, and PCI DSS.

  • Use Wiz or equivalent CNAPP/CSPM to continuously assess, prioritise, and drive remediation of misconfigurations and vulnerabilities against CIS, NIST, and PCI DSS benchmarks.

Security Monitoring

  • Fine tune, and maintain modern SIEM platform (e.g. Sentinel) including KQL detection rules, workbooks, logging pipelines, and AI-assisted alert triage.

  • Map detection coverage against MITRE ATT&CK tactics and techniques. Identify and close visibility gaps across the cloud estate.

  • Maintain alignment to PCI DSS, SOC2, ISO27001 NIST, and CIS frameworks. Produce documentation and evidence to support audit and assurance activities.

AI Security

  • Design and implement guardrails for AI/LLM systems, covering data exposure, prompt injection, and model misuse risks.

  • Leverage AI and automation to enhance alert investigation, enrichment, and response workflows.

  • Maintain technical policies and standards for the secure use of AI tools across the organisation.

What we’re looking for

  • 6+ years of hands-on experience securing AWS, Azure, and GCP environments, including Azure Policy, IAM, Infrastructure-as-code (IAC) security or other cloud native tooling.

  • Experience with security tools: Microsoft Sentinel, SentinelOne, NetSkope, Flashpoint, Wiz or similar tooling.

  • Strong Microsoft Sentinel expertise: KQL, detection rules, workbooks, and logging pipelines.

  • Working knowledge of DLP and threat intelligence monitoring.

  • Experience applying AI/ML to security workflows - automated triage, behavioural analytics, or LLM-assisted investigation.

  • Understanding of AI security risks and frameworks: OWASP LLM Top 10, NIST AI RMF.

  • Scripting proficiency in Python, PowerShell, or Bash for security automation.

  • Strong grasp of PCI DSS, NIST CSF, SOC 2, ISO27001, CIS Benchmarks, and MITRE ATT&CK for Cloud.

Nice to have

  • AZ-500, AWS Certified Security – Specialty, or equivalent cloud security certification.

  • Experience integrating ATT&CK Navigator into SOC workflows.

Additional Information

Bring all of you to work

We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one.

Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands.

We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here.

It’s important we set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter directly, if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable.

Life at

We understand that work is just one part of your life. Our hybrid working model offers flexibility, with three days per week in the office to support collaboration and connection.

title: Experienced Low Level Software Engineer
description:
Mobileye's EyeQ Platform Group in Jerusalem is looking for an embedded SW developer who will be responsible for validating custom hardware in Mobileye SoC.

As an experienced embedded developer, you will be writing C/C++ code for Mobileye vision SoC and be engaged in a wide range of activities: starting from system verification on simulators, moving through the design and implementation of HW drivers for Mobileye's proprietary OS, working closely with ASIC designers to cover all HW features, gaining insight into the inner workings of hardware, and using your knowledge to iron out bugs in silicon on customer boards via JTAG probes. It's a unique opportunity to be part of the complete lifecycle of a system on a chip.

Our group's area of responsibility resides on the SW/HW boundary and thus requires the ability to understand and use complex HW specifications for SW drivers and test development.

What will your job look like?

  • Developing code for a multi-threaded, multi-core system under a custom real-time operating system on MIPS/RISC-V processor range, exposing complex HW features to upper SW layers.

  • Designing and implementing system verification and integration tests in a simulation environment, as well as maintaining and enhancing existing ones.

  • Executing board bring-up activities and debugging existing systems with Mobileye's proprietary system on a chip.

    • All you need is:

  • BSc in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or Electrical Engineering

  • 3+ years of experience in C/C++ programming

  • 3+ years of experience in embedded SW

  • Ability to work with HW specifications and develop low-level SW in bare-metal/RTOS environments

  • Experience in HW/SW integration and debugging activities on real SoC

  • Knowledge of shell scripting and Python

  • Excellent communication and teamwork skills

  • Understanding of embedded systems, microprocessors, I/Os, I2C/SPI, and other interconnect buses – Advantage

  • Experience working with MIPI CSI protocol or other high-speed serial interfaces – Advantage

    • Mobileye changes the way we drive, from preventing accidents to semi and fully autonomous vehicles. If you are an excellent, bright, hands-on person with a passion to make a difference come to lead the revolution!

title: Node.js Senior Engineer (TypeScript & AWS)
description:
This is us

At Avenga, we believe that human creativity empowers technology that matters. This is the job

We are seeking a Senior Backend Engineer with strong experience in Node.js/TypeScript and AWS serverless to design, build, and operate the backend services of Optimus 4.0.

The main focus will be on IoT telemetry ingestion and time-series data processing, APIs consumed by frontend and mobile applications, and ensuring operability of services in production.

This role involves real ownership of critical components. Architectural decisions are made collaboratively with the Tech Lead and Solution Architect, with mandatory documentation (ADRs) in the repository. It is not a pure execution role — we expect technical judgment, initiative, and the ability to raise standards across the team.

  • Proven expertise in AWS serverless: Lambda, IAM, VPC, CloudWatch, and at least two integration services (API Gateway, SQS/SNS, EventBridge, Kinesis, Step Functions).

  • Strong knowledge of PostgreSQL and hands-on experience with Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL (modeling, indexing, performance, transactions, troubleshooting).

  • Experience with high-frequency time-series data: ingestion, window queries, aggregations, retention policies.

  • Daily use of GitHub: PRs, code reviews, branching strategies, CI/CD pipelines.

  • Good practices in testing (unit/integration), observability, and security (secrets management, OWASP, authentication/authorization).

Nice-to-have skills:

  • Production experience with TimescaleDB (hypertables, query optimization, cost control).

  • Familiarity with AWS CodeArtifact, AWS CDK, and Lambda Powertools for TypeScript.

  • Experience with monorepos (Turborepo, NX) and package managers like pnpm.

  • Knowledge of OpenTelemetry/X-Ray, SRE practices (SLOs, error budgets, postmortems).

  • Hybrid experience with containers (Docker, ECS).

  • Industrial/IoT context: SCADA, MES, sensors, industrial protocols.

This is your role

  • Design and implement APIs and serverless services in Node.js/TypeScript on AWS Lambda.

  • Define and maintain event-driven architectures for IoT telemetry ingestion.

  • Optimize Aurora PostgreSQL data models and manage time-series data efficiently.

  • Implement observability end-to-end with actionable alarms, logs, metrics, and traces.

  • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines with GitHub Actions and manage private npm packages with AWS CodeArtifact.

  • Mentor engineers, elevate coding standards, and drive platform improvements.

  • Manage operational risks: concurrency, cold starts, service limits, capacity planning.

What awaits you at Avenga?

  • A long-term project with real ownership of mission-critical components.

  • A collaborative environment where architecture decisions are shared and documented.

  • Opportunities to grow expertise in IoT, serverless-first architectures, and time-series data processing.

  • A culture that values innovation, teamwork, and continuous improvement.

Pratt & Whitney is a world leader in the design, manufacture and service of aircraft engines and auxiliary power systems and has been revolutionizing modern flight for over 100 years. Join us and help shape the future of aerospace and defense.


What you Will Do:

Pratt and Whitney is a global, diverse and innovative technology company that is moving fast to create the future of aviation. The Power Thermal Management Systems Discipline, which is part of Engine Design & System Integration Controls & Diagnostics Systems & Accessories (EDSI CDSA), is seeking a Sr. Systems Engineer to be a part of our world-class systems engineering team. Team members work on multidisciplinary Integrated Product Teams (IPT) to architect, model, develop and integrate state-of-the-art power thermal management systems with propulsion systems and aircraft.

The Control and Diagnostic Systems (CDS) organization is seeking a qualified candidate to perform control system reliability and safety engineering as on-site for military projects.

This job requires employee to work on-site at the PW facility.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Participate in Control & Diagnostic System integrated product teams (IPTs) in development of embedded, real-time control and monitoring systems for military gas turbine engine applications.
  • Collaborate closely with control system, engine system and aircraft design engineers.
  • Work with airframe customers to develop and conduct Functional Hazard Assessments (FHA).
  • Experience in conducting Safety and reliability analysis and reporting, including System Sub-system.
  • Functional Hazard Assessment (SSHA), Failure Mode Effects and Criticality Analysis (FMECA), Fault Tree Analysis (FTA), Common Mode Analysis (CMA), Single Event Effect (SEE, SEU, EMI) Analysis etc.
  • Lead development and execution of Preliminary (PSSA) and final System Safety Assessments (SSA) with airframe customers.
  • Coordinate safety-related activities with internal PW organizations, Module Centers, and external suppliers to support FHA/SSA deliverables.
  • Development of reliability & safety mitigation requirements (redundancy, fault detections, fault accommodations, fault annunciations, maintenance procedures) to ensure robust and fault tolerant control systems design.

Qualifications You Must Have:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Science, Technology, Engineering or Mathematics (STEM)
  • 5 years of engineering experience or 3 years with an advanced degree

Qualifications We Prefer:

  • Proficient in requirements management using DOORS and system safety analysis (using Isograph Reliability Workbench for fault tree analysis), and MBSE (Model Based System Engineering) for control system architecture & software development.
  • Skilled with MATLAB, Simulink and standard engineering productivity tools (MS Office)
    Experience with airworthiness and System Safety Standards, including ARP4754, ARP4764, MIL-STD-882E, MIL-HDBK-516C.

  • Proficient in performing detailed safety analysis for engine control systems and/or aircraft control systems

  • Experience in reviewing requirement verification criteria and test plans.
  • Skilled in integrating subsystems with higher level systems.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment with attention to detail, deadlines and reporting rigor.
    Desire for continuous learning and innovation.

description:
Register Here!

Camunda is the enterprise platform for agentic orchestration, enabling organizations to coordinate AI agents, people, and systems across complex, end-to-end business processes. With built-in governance, auditability, and human oversight, Camunda gives enterprises the control they need to move AI from pilots to production — safely and at scale. Trusted by over 700 organizations worldwide, including 9 of top 10 US banks, Camunda helps enterprises boost operational efficiency, accelerate time-to-value, and deliver better customer experiences.

Fully remote and global, we are in the middle of something bigger: transforming into an AI-first organisation, built on our own platform. We use Agentic AI to automate, orchestrate intelligent processes, and elevate human contribution across every team.

Named GP Bullhound’s Top 100 Next Unicorn list, 2025 Great Place to Work certified. Visionary in 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Business Orchestration and Automation Technologies. ranked 3rd in Flexa's 2026 Most Flexible Companies, We’re growing fast and looking for top talent to join our team. If you want meaningful work, visible impact and put something genuinely rare on your CV, keep reading.

About the role:

If you’re passionate about pushing the limits of reliability, fault-tolerance, and operational excellence in complex distributed systems, Camunda offers the perfect stage.

As a Senior Software Engineer, Backend, you’ll take ownership of automated reliability testing and chaos engineering at the core of Camunda 8. This role thrives on curiosity, experimentation, and relentless improvement—you’ll break things (on purpose!) in safe environments to strengthen our platform before customers ever feel the impact. Here, you’ll make a measurable impact and guide product direction, all while learning new technologies and collaborating with talented, friendly colleagues who live our FAITH values (Focus, Ambition, Integrity, Talent, and Humor).

Every day at Camunda, you’ll help us build robust systems, empower teams, and deliver a great user experience—even in failure scenarios.

Curious about the kind of challenges you'll work on at Camunda? Watch this quick 30-minute talk from our engineers to learn more about the new Camunda Exporter and how we’re solving complex problems at scale

What You’ll Be Doing:

  • Design, implement, and execute automated chaos experiments and reliability tests, validating Camunda's platform under real-world scenarios

    • You will investigate, root-cause and debug potential failures or performance regressions of our Java based products

  • Continuously improve existing load testing, chaos engineering and observability infrastructure to keep our system reliable and performant

    • Here we use different languages, tools and frameworks like java, go, kubernetes, prometheus, grafana, etc.

    • As an example of the above you can check out this CamundaCon recording or this blog post

  • Introduce new tooling and approaches for reliability testing, driving measurable improvements to operational experience and user outcomes (examples from the past: introducing zbchaos as fault injection tool)

  • Collaborate closely with QA and engineering (including cross-functional teams), sharing learnings (e.g. with our team blog) and influencing team roadmaps based on experiment findings

  • Champion a pragmatic, autonomous approach to software design, solving tough problems and learning new principles and technologies (Kubernetes, Helm, Grafana, Java, Go, and more)

  • Advocate for user-centric reliability by using and understanding Camunda’s products firsthand

Defining success for this role:

  • Based on all of the above, you have end to end delivered a concrete task, as for example (the concrete goal will be defined during your onboarding):

  • After 3 months, you have designed and delivered a way to run quick and reproducible load tests, allowing us:

  • to reduce the feedback loops for engineers

  • directly fitting into the development lifecycle

  • Enable engineers to make use of it and extend it

  • After 3 months, you have designed and implemented a realistic, automated, holistic load testing framework for Optimize, in close collaboration with Senior Engineers and Field teams:

  • Conducted a deep-dive analysis of performance limits.

  • Shared results with the relevant core engineering teams and enabled them to re-run the tests.

Documented findings in public-facing documentation to help users better understand performance characteristics and guide their installation design.

What You Bring:

  • Ability and/or willingness to use our product

  • 5+ years of experience in backend software engineering (Java)

  • Proven drive to experiment, learn new tech, and conduct automated reliability and chaos testing in distributed environments

  • Deep enthusiasm for improving performance and fault-tolerance in production systems

  • Autonomous, pragmatic problem-solving skills with an ability to guide and influence others

  • Willingness and ability to use Camunda products and approach reliability from a user’s perspective

Nice to Haves:

  • Hands-on experience with Go or other languages, in a multi-language context

  • Working as SRE on distributed systems, with a strong software engineering mindset before

  • Working knowledge of Kubernetes, Helm Charts, Operators, and related production infrastructure

  • Experience running apps in production, with solid skills in monitoring, troubleshooting, and performance analysis

  • Background in chaos engineering, automated reliability, load, or performance testing

We're backed by General Catalyst and world-class healthcare + consumer investors, and we're growing like crazy â€” in 2025 we grew 1100%, and are on track to 5x in 2026.

If you want to be a part of the generationally defining company in mental health, welcome home.

Role Overview

We're looking for a Lead React Engineer to join our small, high-ownership engineering team and help build the core web experiences that power our mentors and ops team.

The work is high agency, high craft, and high impact:

You will directly shape the platform experiences that help teens stay, connect, and genuinely get better.

What You'll Do

You won't just "build features." You'll take full ownership of core missions tied directly to our 2026 strategy:

1. Elevate our Mentor Operations Platform from functional to world-class

  • Ship web experiences that feel fast, reliable, and deeply human
  • Elevate the mentor web experience from "functional and fragmented" to cohesive, elegant, and best-in-class
  • Build UI that feels as intuitive and polished as the best consumer-grade software
  • Sweat performance, accessibility, and interaction quality â€” not just feature delivery

2. Build tools that safely scale our mentor operation

  • Create mentor-facing features that increase consistency, speed, and connection
  • Build safety surfaces that proactively detect risk and reduce human error
  • Improve mentor workflows so they feel empowered, not burdened, by our tools

3. Own full-stack product development

  • Build end-to-end features across React, backend services, and APIs
  • Collaborate closely with design, product, growth, and clinical ops
  • Run user conversations with mentors and ops staff to deeply understand needs
  • Maintain a clean, scalable codebase as we grow quickly

Who You Are

  • You have 4+ years of professional software engineering experience, including deep work with React
  • You have a strong understanding of web app architecture, common design patterns, and performance optimization
  • You're comfortable with modern web engineering workflows â€” CI/CD pipelines, testing frameworks, deployment â€” and you enjoy improving them
  • You love building pixel-perfect, fast, and reliable user interfaces across screen sizes
  • You care deeply about quality and craft, and you're motivated by creating products that real people love using
  • You're a clear, direct, and thoughtful communicator who collaborates well with others

Minimum Qualifications

  • Strong proficiency in JavaScript and TypeScript, and modern React patterns (components, hooks, state management)
  • Experience building and shipping complex, production-grade React web applications
  • Hands-on experience integrating REST/GraphQL APIs, authentication flows, and real-time data (e.g. WebSockets)
  • Experience with state management libraries such as Zustand, Jotai, Redux, or TanStack Query
  • Strong understanding of web performance, accessibility (WCAG), and responsive design
  • Experience with CSS-in-JS or utility-first CSS systems (e.g. Tailwind, styled-components)
  • Experience using Git, writing unit and integration tests, and working within CI/CD pipelines
  • Bonus: experience with Next.js, SSR/SSG patterns, or full-stack TypeScript (tRPC, Prisma, etc.)

How We Work

We're building a culture that blends high performance, deep belonging, and radical clarity:

  • We care about outcomes, not theatrics
  • We move quickly and learn constantly
  • We speak the truth early
  • We protect focus
  • We hold a high bar for craft and quality
  • We're small, intense, collaborative, and mission-driven
  • We care about each other, and we care about the millions of teens we serve

If you're looking for a place where you can have real ownership and build something that genuinely changes lives, this is it.

Work Environment

  • This is a full-time hybrid position in person in our NYC office in Williamsburg. We consider fully remote for exceptional talent.
  • We have an output-driven culture and provide lots of flexibility throughout the week as needed.

What We Offer

  • The annual salary range for this position is $180,000 - $250,000.
  • Significant equity compensation, reflecting your foundational role and impact.
  • Comprehensive health insurance coverage.
  • Significant work ownership and autonomy

title: Principal Product Manager - Enterprise Readiness
description:
Overview

Company background

At Atlassian, our mission is to unleash the potential of every team. We build tools that help teams plan, collaborate, and deliver great work together. Our products support millions of users globally, from software and IT teams to business teams driving company-wide outcomes.

We are building the future of work with a strong point of view on how people, teams, and AI can work better together. In Strategy Collection, that means creating enterprise-grade products that help organizations connect strategy to execution while meeting the security, compliance, governance, deployment, and integration requirements of the world’s largest customers.

  • We value open collaboration, clear thinking, and practical innovation that solves real customer problems.

  • We invest in thoughtful, trustworthy AI experiences that improve decisions and reduce friction without sacrificing transparency or control.

  • We give product leaders meaningful ownership, strong cross-functional partners, and the chance to shape products used by modern organizations at scale.

Role Overview

We're looking for an experienced, results-driven Principal Product Manager to own Enterprise Readiness for Focus within Atlassian's Strategy Collection product management team. Strategy Collection is Atlassian’s "roof of the house" for the Atlassian System of Work, aligning company strategy to execution. This role will turn enterprise readiness from a broad theme into a clear operating plan that removes adoption blockers for large enterprises, regulated customers, implementation partners, and mid-market teams evaluating Focus.

You will define the strategy, roadmap, and operating cadence for capabilities such as public APIs, permissions and governance, data residency and compliance pathways such as FedRAMP. This is a hands-on, highly cross-functional role that requires strong technical judgment, customer empathy, enterprise SaaS depth, and the ability to influence product, engineering, platform, security, legal, GTM, and executive stakeholders. This role reports directly to the Head of Product of Strategy Collection.

Responsibilities

Responsibilities

  • Define and own the Enterprise Readiness vision, roadmap, and operating plan for Focus within Strategy Collection, translating customer, partner, and compliance needs into clear priorities and shipped outcomes.

  • Build and maintain a readiness map across shipped, in-flight, blocked, and missing capabilities, including public APIs, permissions, audit logs, data share, automation, sandboxes, etc.

  • Prioritize work based on customer impact, revenue protection and growth, enterprise security gates, partner enablement, and risk reduction for strategic accounts in regulated industries.

  • Drive critical cross-functional initiatives and enterprise readiness definition of “done” for future launches.

  • Partner deeply with engineering, design, platform, security, compliance, legal, data, GTM, support, and partner teams to align owners, dependencies, milestones, and escalation paths across Focus and platform-owned work.

  • Translate complex enterprise requirements into pragmatic product decisions, balancing near-term blockers with a durable strategy for security, governance, scale, extensibility, and admin control.

  • Use customer evidence, partner feedback, account data, risk assessment, and product telemetry to size opportunities, make tradeoffs, and communicate the business case for investment.

  • Create clear executive-ready narratives on current state, top risks, roadmap choices, and progress against outcomes; proactively escalate when commitments, customer trust, or revenue are at risk.

  • Establish lightweight cadences and accountability mechanisms so enterprise readiness becomes part of how Focus ships, not a post-GA remediation effort.

Compensation

At Atlassian, we strive to design equitable, explainable, and competitive compensation programs. We follow consistent hiring practices and account for each candidate's skills, knowledge, and experience when setting base pay within the range.

This role may also be eligible for benefits, bonuses, commissions, and equity.

Qualifications

Qualifications

  • 8+ years of Product Management experience, including significant ownership of enterprise SaaS products, platform capabilities, or infrastructure-heavy product areas.

  • Proven ability to lead ambiguous, cross-functional initiatives with high executive visibility and multiple dependent teams, especially where product outcomes depend on platform, security, compliance, or infrastructure work.

  • Strong enterprise SaaS fluency across security, compliance, governance, administration, deployment architecture, extensibility, and scaled operations.

  • Experience with enterprise-grade capabilities such as public APIs, permissions/RBAC, audit logs, data residency, BYOK/CMK, single-tenant or isolated cloud deployments, sandboxes, automation, data sharing, identity/access management, or compliance certifications such as FedRAMP, HIPAA, ISO, SOC2, GDPR, or CCPA.

  • Ability to work credibly with engineering and platform teams on technical tradeoffs, dependencies, sequencing, migration plans, and risk mitigation without needing to own implementation details.

  • Exceptional customer and market judgment, with experience synthesizing input from large enterprise customers, regulated industries, implementation partners, sales, success, support, and security reviews.

  • Strong strategic thinking and prioritization skills, including the ability to connect enterprise readiness work to revenue protection, adoption, customer trust, partner ecosystem growth, and long-term product strategy.

  • Outstanding written and verbal communication skills, including crisp executive narratives, clear operating plans, and the ability to influence stakeholders without relying on formal authority.

  • Track record of driving teams from ambiguity to execution: defining scope, owners, success metrics, milestones, risks, and decision points.

  • Experience with Atlassian products, strategy/portfolio management, enterprise collaboration products, regulated customers, or partner-led implementation motions is a strong plus.

Job Locations US-VA-Chantilly | US-CO-Colorado Springs | US-CA-El Segundo ID 2026-1976 Category Systems Engineer Required Security Clearance TS/SCI (SSBI) Type Full-Time
Overview

Stellar Solutions, a nationally recognized "Great Place To Work," delivers engineering solutions across commercial space and national security missions-from innovative new entrants to established space systems organizations.

We bring talented, energetic, and immediately productive professionals to meet critical customer needs in systems engineering and integration, mission operations, program management, and strategic planning, helping teams deliver resilient capability to the mission with speed, quality, and focus.

Stellar Solutions is seeking a Senior Systems Engineer to support a proposed Environmental Monitoring mission area within a broader Space-Based Sensing and Tracking enterprise.

This role provides senior systems engineering, mission engineering, requirements, technical governance, and acquisition-support expertise for government customers standing up, inheriting, assessing, and scaling space-based sensing programs at varying stages of maturity. The role helps government customers establish technical baselines, assess inherited program maturity, develop requirements, impose consistent engineering governance, and guide mission-area execution from early definition through IOC and FOC.

Role/Responsibilities/Qualifications

This is a senior technical leadership role for a systems engineer who can operate across mission, acquisition, engineering, contractor, and operational-user communities. The role supports Environmental Monitoring capabilities within a broader space-based sensing enterprise and helps align technical baselines, requirements, interfaces, and mission outcomes across programs at different lifecycle stages.


Key responsibilities include:

    Provide senior level systems engineering support to the Environmental Monitoring mission area.
  • Provide systems engineering and mission engineering support across the full lifecycle, including concept definition, requirements development, architecture assessment, integration planning, verification, transition, and sustainment.
  • Support technical baseline assessments for inherited or existing programs, including review of requirements, architecture products, interface documentation, test artifacts, risk posture, and maturity against mission objectives.
  • Establish consistent technical governance across programs that may be at different lifecycle stages.
  • Support Define-Assess-Forecast-Build activities by identifying technical competencies, expertise gaps, program maturity, workforce needs, and scaling priorities.
  • Develop, refine, and manage mission-level requirements, system requirements, technical baselines, interface needs, and performance measures.
  • Coordinate across government program leadership, PD/PO teams, acquisition stakeholders, technical SMEs, contractors, ground systems teams, mission users, and enterprise-level engineering leadership.
  • Support mission thread development, requirements traceability, operational use-case definition, and transition from mission need to executable engineering and acquisition plans.
  • Advise customer leadership on technical risk, requirements quality, architecture maturity, program readiness, integration gaps, and mission-area governance.
  • Support acquisition engineering activities, including technical input to acquisition strategies, RFPs, SOWs/PWSs, evaluation criteria, technical reviews, CDRLs, and contractor oversight.
  • Ensure Environmental Monitoring capabilities align with SBST lines of effort, enterprise standards, digital-engineering objectives, and progression toward IOC and FOC.
  • Use digital engineering, MBSE, architecture frameworks, model-based methods, or model repositories where useful to improve traceability, integration, analysis, and decision quality; tailor the approach to mission and program needs rather than treating tools as the objective.
  • Translate complex technical and mission needs into clear decision materials, executive briefings, engineering recommendations, and customer-facing guidance.

Required Qualifications

  • 12+ years of systems engineering, mission engineering, acquisition support, SETA, government advisory, space systems, ISR, GEOINT, remote sensing, environmental monitoring, or national security space experience.
  • Experience supporting government space, satellite, remote sensing, radar/RF, SAR, GEOINT, ISR, environmental monitoring, Earth observation, ground systems, or mission-data programs.
  • Strong understanding of the systems engineering lifecycle, including requirements development, architecture assessment, interface management, technical baseline development, risk management, verification, validation, and transition to operations.
  • Experience supporting technical governance, engineering reviews, program readiness assessments, or cross-contractor integration.
  • Prior support to agencies or mission environments such as SDA, SSC, NRO, NGA, AFRL, USSF, MDA, NOAA, NASA, USGS, DoD, IC, or related federal customers.
  • Ability to work across technical, acquisition, contractor, and operational-user communities.
  • Strong communication skills, including experience preparing executive-level briefings, technical assessments, engineering recommendations, and decision materials.

Desired Qualifications

  • Experience with Environmental Monitoring, space-based sensing, radar/RF sensing, SAR, GEOINT, ISR, remote sensing, commercial satellite data, or mission-data dissemination.
  • Experience supporting SETA, FFRDC, government advisory, acquisition-support, or technical program-management contracts.
  • Familiarity with digital engineering, MBSE, architecture frameworks, mission threads, CONOPS, ICDs, V&V, risk registers, CDRLs, technical baselines, or requirements traceability.
  • Experience assessing programs at varying levels of maturity and helping customers impose consistent engineering discipline across non-uniform program portfolios.

Clearance & Additional Requirements

  • U.S. citizenship is required.

Your mission, alongside the team, is to build and operate the framework to ensure Mistral’s solution delivery is reliable and sustainable - and applied uniformly across all our accounts, both Mistral-hosted and customer-hosted. You will operate in four concurrent modes:

- BUILD - Design for a fleet of Mistral platforms and apps. Build proactivity to reduce reactivity.
Productize reliability, author runbooks, create SLO templates, implement observability.
- RUN - Operate the Tier-1 customer environments that Mistral are contracted to operate.
Ensure SLO compliance, own on-call and incident response, manage drift, partner with Technical Support as L3 escalation, champion high signal post-mortems.
- ENABLE - Productize how Mistral deploy, secure, and scale our Applied AI solutions.
Engineer on-demand provisioning, author security baseline packages, embed security guardrails, automate everything.
- SECURE - Own the security operations layer for our customer-side deployments.
Lead CVE response across the fleet, ship supply-chain integrity controls (SBOM, signed images, provenance), co-page with InfoSec on security incidents, enforce secure-config baselines.

This is a framework-first, fleet management role at heart. If you're excited by the difference between solving one customer's problem and structurally solving the class of problem for every customer, this is the role.


How We Work in Applied AI

• We care about people and outputs.
• What matters is what you ship, not the time you spend on it
• Bureaucracy is where urgency goes to vanish. You talk to whoever you need to talk to. The best idea wins, whether it comes from a principal engineer or someone in their first week.
• Always ask why. The best solutions come from deep understanding, not from copying what worked before
• We say what we mean. Feedback is direct, timely, and given because we care.
• No politics. Low ego, high standards.
• We embrace an unstructured environment and find joy in it.


About you

• Fluent in English.
• 5+ years in SRE, Production Engineering, or DevOps, with a record of shipping tooling.

• Strong multi-tenant Kubernetes fluency, namespace segmentation, network policy, RBAC, admission control, operations at scale.

• On-call discipline: incident response, blameless post-mortem culture, runbook-first mindset.

• Observability stack in production: Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, Loki, Tempo, Signoz.

• Infrastructure as code: Terraform, Ansible (or close equivalents).

• Proficient in Python and/or Golang for tooling and automation.

• Security mindset: you treat secure-SDLC, CVE response, and supply-chain integrity as reliability properties of the shipped artifact, not as someone else's job.

• Strong written communication skills: runbooks, post-mortems, and customer-facing incident comms are core deliverables of this role.

• Comfortable operating with high autonomy in an ambiguous, fast-paced environment — and disciplined enough to defend the team's scope when work tries to spill in.

• Solid Linux internals, networking debug, and distributed-systems fundamentals.


Strong plus

• Cloud or application security background (AppSec, K8s security, supply chain — SBOM, cosign, SLSA). At least one of our early hires must bring this; if it's you, flag it.

• Experience operating LLM / model-serving stacks in production

• Experience with multi-cloud or on-prem hybrid customer environments (AWS, GCP, Azure, sovereign clouds).

  • Creating Multi-Region Talent Pipelines: You’ll be responsible for scaling and nurturing diverse, high-performing candidate pipelines across our key global entities, ensuring a standardized yet culturally adaptable approach to discovering future leaders.

  • Designing Global Recruitment Strategies: You’ll spearhead the creation of high-quality, standardized recruitment and assessment processes. This includes designing cutting-edge, centralized assessment centers and ensuring a flawless, world-class candidate experience globally.

  • Managing the End-to-End Program Lifecycle: You will take global ownership of the entire Early Careers journey, ensuring programs run seamlessly from initial application configurations to program graduation and permanent team placement.

  • Enabling Global Managers & Nurturing Hubs: A great program needs world-class support. You will build toolkits, frameworks, and training modules to enable international hiring managers to effectively mentor, manage, and accelerate early-career talent on the ground.

  • Cross-Functional & Regional Collaboration: You will partner closely with regional Talent Acquisition stakeholders and People Partners worldwide to ensure local programs align beautifully with our global standards while matching regional business operational structures.

What we’re looking for:

  • Ambitious & High Energy: You don’t just want to execute a playbook; you want to build a legacy. You bring a high level of energy, urgency, and passion to everything you do, motivated by making a lasting impact on young careers.

  • Master of Global Stakeholder Management: You excel at building trust and navigating diverse perspectives across international leadership teams. You can align corporate objectives with regional nuances to ensure universal program buy-in.

  • Creative & Forward-Thinking Architect: You challenge the status quo of traditional graduate schemes. You bring fresh, innovative ideas to talent attraction, and you are excited to embed emerging tools (like AI literacy and automated skills mapping) into the program structure.

  • Natural Networker & Community Builder: You genuinely love connecting with people. You are naturally skilled at inspiring a room full of graduates, managing corporate relationships, or collaborating with academic deans.

  • Data-Driven Problem Solver: You treat talent acquisition as an optimization problem. When you detect process friction, pipeline bottlenecks, or retention gaps, you proactively design structural, measurable solutions.

  • Collaborative Global Spirit: You thrive in a borderless environment, working seamlessly with international teams to deliver localized impact backed by global alignment.

Why join:

This is a unique opportunity to fundamentally own and scale a world-class NextGen brand from our global headquarters. You will enjoy the autonomy to innovate locally in London while steering the strategic direction of a supportive, global team. If you are passionate about defining how the next generation of global fintech talent is discovered and developed, we would love to meet you.

We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one.

Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands.

We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here.

title: Software Engineer - Data Infrastructure
description:
About the role

Coragrid is looking for a Software Engineer to help build our data infrastructure, data quality systems, and traceability tools for private-company intelligence.

You will build systems that help institutional investors trust private-company data with unmatched accuracy, clear source evidence, and full traceability.


Who are we

Coragrid builds data infrastructure for private markets. Our goal is to bring public-market level data fidelity to private companies. We process official financials, registry filings, and web evidence while preserving the direct link to the underlying documents.

We care about speed, truthfulness, and low-friction tools. Our product is built for investment teams and technical teams that need source-linked private-company data they can trust.


How we work

  • Clear command-line tools

We are looking for a versatile engineer to complement our team. You will work on progressing the development of pellet injector technologies and integrated systems. Whether you are coding a 1-D model or selecting components for a test setup, your work will contribute directly to commercial fusion becoming a reality.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

    1. Develop test methodology and plans

    3. Collaborate with established institutions

  • The "Maker" Mindset: You are someone who can solder a sensor to a cable before adapting the data evaluation tool you wrote.

  • Skilled in Technology Evaluation: You have experience with early stage, first-principles modelling and simulation, particularly as applied to technology trade studies; experience with Python is a strong plus.

  • Adaptability: You thrive in a startup environment where the scope of activities can shift. If you have a unique skill (like high-power lasers or high-energy ballistics), we can adjust the role to leverage it.

title: Entrepreneur in Residence (m/f/d)
description:
About Buena

Buena is building the technology that real estate runs on. We're making every part of real estate – from finding and financing to buying and managing – as seamless and transparent as possible. We do this by acquiring property managers across Germany and rebuilding them as technology companies. In under three years and with fewer than 25 people at HQ, we've already become Germany's second-largest property manager. The next trillion dollar company in real estate won't sell software. It will run the industry.

About the Entrepreneur in Residence role

We're hiring a Entrepreneur in Residence to own one of our next revenue verticals from zero.

Property management is our entry point, but every unit we manage opens the door to adjacent businesses, complementing an end-to-end real estate experience for our customers. These verticals are also worth billions: Brokerage when owners sell. Energy and metering services on every building we touch. Insurance. Financing. The list keeps growing.

You'll own the P&L, the strategy, the partnerships, and the product.

Responsibilities

  • Own the P&L for your Vertical. Revenue, margin, payback.

  • Drive the product, don't request it. Our software runs property management today. You'll define what needs to exist for your vertical to work, write the spec, work directly with our PMs and engineers, and ship it. If you need a feature, you fill the product manager role until it's built.

  • Roll out across all portcos: One good deal × 60,000+ units. You design the rollout, measure it, and ship the playbook so it works the same way in every portco.

You may be a good fit if you

  • You've started something before. A company you founded, a product you built and sold, a freelance business you scaled. You know what it means when no one is going to do it for you.

  • You think commercially first. Unit economics, margin, payback, deal structure. You don't need to learn this, you already think this way.

  • You won't be a brokerage or banking expert on day one. You'll be one in 60 days because you'll outresearch and outthink everyone: including the people who've been in the industry for 20 years.

  • You act fast. Reversible decisions don't get a second meeting. You move, get the information, and adjust.

  • You can sell. You've personally closed deals, signed partners, or convinced people to give you money.

  • You speak native-level German. Most partners, regulators, and customers operate in German, sometimes with heavy accent. This is a hard requirement.

  • You work from our office in Prenzlauer Berg. This is not a remote role, not even hybrid.

Bonus: The instinct of "this is mine, I'll figure it out" is what we're hiring for.

Your first 90 days

Days 1–14: Property management before vertical.

Every vertical at Buena is built on top of property management, so before you build yours, you'll work in it. You'll handle tickets, call customers and tenants, onboard new owners, digitalize documents, run cost audits in portcos, and solve whatever shows up that day. This is how you'll learn the systems, the economics, and the operational reality your vertical depends on.

You'll meet most of the HQ team in your first day. You’ll have daily check-ins (morning and evening) with Jan for the first two weeks to sync on how you each think and work. You'll also get a first book to read (which we’ll discuss thereafter)

Days 14–30: Start building the vertical.

You start writing your Day 90 plan: the bets, the metrics, and the resources. You visit your first portfolio company in person. We sign you up for the WEG Verwalter examination at IHK. By Day 30, the plan is final and you're building.

Days 30–60: Ship the first wins.

Ops weekly with your peers, monthly Portfolio Review where you'll present your vertical to the rest of the company. Daily check-ins are reduced to weeklies.

This is where the first obvious wins land. Not "we're making progress," but revenue or signed partners or a closed pilot that doesn't need a slide to explain.

Days 60–90: Own it.

By Day 90: you're a certified WEG Verwalter, all requests and problems related to your vertical flow to you and stop there, and you've got first profits on the board. You've also got a roadmap for the next 90 days that goes beyond "more of the same."

You’ll have read three books together by then.

Your Benefits

  • Up to €500 close-to-office bonus, if you decide to live within 10-20 mins walking distance to our office.

  • €110/month lunch budget, €50 fitness subsidy.

  • €1,200 yearly education budget.

  • Free books: Buena pays for any book you'd like to read.

Why you should apply now

  • We're high-growth with a small, tight-knit team: In less than three years we have become Germany's second-largest property manager with around 25 full-time employees in the HQ

  • We're meritocratic: Your impact gets rewarded, quickly. Our CEO started here as a Junior Product Manager three years ago, our COO started here as the Chief of Staff two years ago. Our VP Property Management joined as a Junior Integration Manager.

  • We're personal: We work from our office in Prenzlauer Berg and place high value on knowing each other well.

  • We care about outcomes: Homeownership rates in Germany are far below Global average. We're here to enable wealth creation for everyone.

description:
