title: Staff Backend Sofware Engineer - Agent Platform (Java)
description:
Our Purpose

At SentinelOne, we are driven by a clear purpose: to give the advantage to those who secure our future. As AI reshapes how organizations build, operate, and innovate, the responsibility to protect them becomes more critical than ever. When you join SentinelOne, your work helps protect global enterprises, critical infrastructure, and the technologies shaping tomorrow. If you are motivated by meaningful challenges and want your impact to be real, measurable, and global, you will find purpose here.

About Us

SentinelOne is a company at the intersection of AI and security, pioneering a new operating model for cybersecurity. Our AI-native platform unifies protection across endpoint, cloud, identity, data, and AI systems to deliver autonomous detection and response with clarity and speed. By combining real-time analytics, intelligent automation, and a unified data foundation, we reduce noise, simplify complexity, and empower security teams to focus on what truly matters.

Our teams are builders, problem-solvers, and innovators committed to shaping the future of security. If you are excited to solve hard problems alongside talented, mission-driven people, we invite you to help us build a safer future for humanity.

What Are We Looking For?

We’re looking for people who are relentlessly curious and committed to continuous learning. AI is reshaping every function across our business, and we enable every team member, regardless of role or level, to build fluency in AI tools and concepts. Those who thrive here actively seek out new solutions, experiment thoughtfully, and apply what they learn to drive better, faster, smarter outcomes.

As a Staff Backend Software Engineer, Agent Platform, you will be tasked with joining our team supporting SentinelOne's main product line, Endpoint Protection, which secures tens of millions of devices across the globe of all kinds of OS (Windows, Linux, macOS) and processes billions of security events every day. You will provide crucial SaaS platform capabilities, including high-throughput, highly available services for policy, configuration, and command distribution to millions of agents around the world. You will collaborate closely with agent detection, agent health, and core platform teams to turn new protection ideas into robust, operable capabilities at scale.

What Will You Do?

Primary responsibilities include:

  • Design, develop, implement, test, document, and operate large-scale, high-volume, and low latency applications, built to handle several millions of events per second.
  • Translate business and functional requirements into robust, scalable, operable solutions that work well within the overall data architecture.
  • Participate and collaborate with cross-functional teams in both your organization and other organizations at S1, to understand the business requirements and to deliver solutions that can scale.
  • Maintain application stability and data integrity by monitoring key metrics and improving the codebase accordingly.
  • Understand and maintain the existing codebase by regular re-factoring and applying requested fixes and features.
  • Learn new technologies that can solve our huge volume of data and the challenges it poses.
  • Build the agent platform protocol for other SentinelOne teams to build upon and ship new security and detection capabilities safely and quickly, while ensuring the reliability, scalability, and observability of the agent fleet in production so customers and internal teams have real-time insight into fleet health and coverage.
  • Work with our toolkit, developing new components primarily in Java (with Go and Python also used in our current backend environment); facilitating communication between microservices using gRPC, REST, GraphQL APIs, and Kafka depending on specific requirements; using Redis, PostgreSQL, Cassandra, ClickHouse, and our own columnar time-series database for efficient event storage and retrieval at scale; deploying services across multiple AWS/GCP regions with Kubernetes; and using tools such as Docker, GitHub, and ArgoCD, along with company access to various modern AI-powered tools for both R&D and non-R&D tasks.

What Skills and Knowledge Will You Bring?

Ideal candidates will have:

  • 8 years of professional backend development experience in Java (preferred) and/or Golang, understanding of Python is a plus.
  • Ability to quickly dive into new products and understand their inner workings.
  • A self-driven approach as an individual contributor.
  • Experience with designing large-scale high-load distributed systems and their performance.
  • Experience with AWS, GCP, and/or other cloud platforms, and with Docker, Helm, and Kubernetes.
  • Excellent communication skills, as you will be regularly in touch with Product, Technical Account Managers (who provide feedback from clients), and other cross-functional teams, and you will put into use your ability to influence technical direction and mentor others.
  • Experience with Kafka, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis.
  • Experience in an enterprise SaaS company or cybersecurity software company is highly preferred.

Why SentinelOne?

AI is redefining how the world operates and rewriting the rules of security in real time, and SentinelOne was built for this moment. From day one, we architected an AI-native platform designed to operate at machine speed, not as an add-on to legacy systems but as the foundation itself. If you want to build where innovation and impact move together, this is that place.

We invest in our Sentinels with comprehensive, competitive benefits designed to support you and your family:

Equity & Rewards

  • Restricted Stock Units (RSUs)
  • Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP)

Time Off & Wellbeing

  • Flexible time off
  • Paid company holidays and paid sick time
  • Gender-neutral parental leave

Insurance & Financial Security

  • 401(k) retirement plan with company match

Work Perks & Flexibility

  • Home office allowance

Wellness & Lifestyle

  • Wellness coach
  • Wellness/gym reimbursement
  • Fertility coverage
  • Adoption & surrogacy reimbursement

title: Senior Financial Reporting Analyst
description:
🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.

We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.

After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as personal and business bank accounts, we offer joint accounts, accounts for 16-17 year olds, a free kids account and credit cards in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also save, invest and combine their pensions with us.

With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!

We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️

📍London | 💰£60,000 - £70,000 ➕ Incentive Awards tied to your performance | Benefits | Hear from the team ✨

⭐ Our Finance team

We're looking for a highly proactive, enthusiastic and commercially-minded Financial Reporting Senior Analyst to join our Financial Reporting team, and help us build a world-class finance function. This role would be well suited to a fully qualified Chartered Accountant with an audit background.

We have some really exciting challenges coming up like expanding into the European Union, the introduction of Monzo Mobile and Habito to our group, climate change reporting, continuing to grow our customer base, growing our lending business and adding to our marketplace. You’ll work on scaling Monzo in a controlled way, while helping us optimise our financial reporting processes with the help of technology. You’ll join the Finance team and report to our Financial Reporting Manager.

🔑 You’ll play a key role by...

  • Understanding the business and our products to write insightful management commentary.
  • Working with our engineers and data teams to automate the production elements of this role, allowing you to focus on the parts of the role where your knowledge and skills provide the most value.
  • Understanding our accounting system and making sure we are taking advantage of all its features to minimise manual elements of reporting.
  • Being responsible for ensuring our financial reporting policies, procedures and controls are up to date, relevant and useful for Monzo and importantly are scalable.
  • Supporting the full year end process, from drafting the annual report to working with external auditors until final sign-off.
  • Reviewing new products, assessing the accounting and implementing them in our banking platform and accounting system.
  • Working with the business to assess the impact of changes in accounting standards and make proposals on accounting policy matters for new products launched.
  • Maintaining existing and develop new controls that protect our financial data and our balance sheet substantiation process
  • Assisting with the implementation of our new accounting system to make sure we are taking advantage of all its features to minimise manual elements of reporting
  • Supporting on the production of ESG sustainability reporting and disclosures
  • Preparing monthly management and adhoc reports, offering meaningful analysis of movements.
  • Reviewing and assessing the accounting impact of new contracts, working closely with the business and legal team before contracts are signed to establish the correct accounting treatment.
  • Supporting tight processes with our internal finance team to ensure a swift month-end close process.
  • Resolving miscellaneous inquiries and supporting the overall finance team wherever needed - from forecasting and valuations, to bank transfers and tax policy research!

🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…

  • You’re a qualified chartered accountant (ACA or CA) and ideally have audit experience combined with financial reporting and control experience outside of practice.
  • You have a great eye for detail
  • You’re fascinated by the banking and regulatory landscape, and have a good understanding of key financial controls
  • You’re a self-starter and enjoy tackling what needs doing, whether it’s making a bank transfer or pulling together reports for investors
  • You’re comfortable translating complex information into simple words for people with diverse backgrounds
  • Highly comfortable with leveraging data to automate reporting and drive efficiency (SQL skills would be a bonus)
  • You thrive in a dynamic and constantly evolving environment
  • Nice to have (one or more)
    • Experience in a listed company or financial services regulated environment.

title: Health and Safety Lead
description:
WHO WE ARE

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.

WHY JOIN PROXIMA FUSION

  • You will get to work on some of the most complex tech challenges to bring abundant, safe, clean energy to the world.

  • Get to show that big things are possible in Europe when you assemble the best talent.

YOUR IMPACT

As Health and Safety Manager, you will own and lead Proxima Fusion’s Health & Safety strategy and operations across our sites in Munich, Switzerland, and the UK. You will establish a consistent, high-performing safety culture across the company while ensuring compliance with local regulations and industry best practices.

You will partner closely with facilities, engineering, laboratory, manufacturing, operations, and leadership teams to create safe environments that enable world-class scientific and engineering work. This is a highly cross-functional role with company-wide visibility and impact.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Own and continuously improve Proxima Fusion’s Health & Safety framework across all company locations

  • Develop, implement, and maintain company-wide H&S policies, procedures, standards, and management systems

  • Ensure compliance with applicable German, Swiss, and UK health and safety regulations

  • Coordinate best practices and harmonize safety processes across laboratories, workshops, office environments, and technical facilities

  • Support contractor management, permit-to-work systems, and safe working procedures

  • Develop and deliver H&S training, onboarding, emergency response exercises, and awareness programs

  • Build a proactive and positive safety culture through coaching, engagement, and continuous improvement initiatives

  • Advise leadership on strategic H&S priorities, risks, and mitigation plans

WHO YOU ARE

  • You are experienced in building and scaling H&S systems across multiple sites or international operations

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Ready for a challenge?

Then Just Eat Takeaway.com might be the place for you. We’re a leading global online delivery platform, and our vision is to empower everyday convenience.
Whether it’s a Friday-night feast, a post-gym poke bowl, or grabbing some groceries, our tech platform connects tens of millions of customers with hundreds of thousands of restaurant, grocery and convenience partners across the globe

About this role

We're looking for an experienced Senior Data Engineer to join the Insights & Enablement team within Retail Media Tech at JET. This team sits at the heart of JET's retail media data platform, responsible for the infrastructure, pipelines, and data products that power how advertisers understand, optimise, and grow their campaigns on the JET platform.

This is not a typical Senior Data Engineer role. You'll work across the full stack of modern data engineering ranging from event streaming and attribution pipelines to Gold Layer data marts and AI-powered tooling and you'll help shape the technical foundation that underpins our retail media platform at scale. You'll partner closely with data scientists, analytical engineers, product managers, and ML engineers to turn complex data challenges into reliable, scalable production systems.

We're building a lot: a TopRank Sponsored Listings data platform on BigQuery and dbt, a semantic layer serving Tableau and Looker Studio, Snowplow-based event attribution infrastructure, and agentic AI tooling for Post-Campaign Analysis. You'll have the opportunity to work on all of it.

Critically, this role operates in a highly cross-functional environment. You'll work alongside JET's central Data & Analytics organisation, Platform Engineering, and other technology teams aligning on shared infrastructure standards, contributing to joint working groups, and ensuring retail media data products integrate cleanly with the broader JET data ecosystem.

As a senior member of the team, you'll do more than code you'll help define best practices, mentor engineers, and raise the technical bar across the team.

These are some of the key components to the position:

  • Design and build scalable data pipelines and event streaming architectures across batch and near-real-time workloads, with a focus on reliability and data quality.
  • Develop and maintain Gold Layer data marts in BigQuery using dbt Core, with a strong grasp of top-down/bottom-up data modelling methodologies (Kimball, OBT, or equivalent).
  • Build and maintain Airflow-orchestrated ELT workflows across the retail media data platform, including attribution pipelines supporting campaign performance and incrementality measurement.
  • Contribute to Retail Media event tracking infrastructure, schema governance, SLA/SLO monitoring, and data quality validation across the unified events pipeline.
  • Support the development of a semantic layer (Cube.dev/Helix) bridging BigQuery Gold tables to downstream BI tooling.
  • Begin to contribute to architecture discussions beyond your immediate team, identifying improvement points in individual components and the system as a whole, with a clear path to shaping platform-level decisions at Staff level.
  • Embed DataOps best practices across the team: CI/CD, testing, observability, data drift monitoring, and incident response using tools like Grafana and Datadog.
  • Collaborate with ML engineers and data scientists to productionise models and agentic tooling built on internal AI platforms, with hands-on use of AI-assisted development tools such as Claude.ai, OpenAI, GitHub Copilot, and Cursor as part of your everyday engineering workflow.
  • Work cross-functionally with Data & Analytic
  • s, Platform Engineering, and other JET technology teams, contributing to shared standards, joint initiatives, and platform-level decisions that affect the broader data estate.
  • Mentor engineers within the team and contribute to technical documentation, decision-making frameworks, and engineering standards.

What will you bring to the team?

  • Demonstrable senior-level experience building and delivering data engineering solutions, including distributed systems, event-driven architectures, and large-scale data processing (batch and streaming).

  • Strong Python skills and solid SQL across BigQuery or equivalent cloud data warehouses; familiarity with Scala or Java is a plus.
  • Deep expertise in data pipeline design: batch vs. streaming, ETL/ELT, schema design, partitioning, and efficient storage patterns.
  • Hands-on experience with dbt Core (or dbt Cloud) and Airflow for orchestration and transformation at scale.

At L2 you will implement security controls, respond to security incidents, identify risks, and support compliance activities across multiple domains. You work independently for extended periods and are developing the cross-domain knowledge and stakeholder skills that will prepare you for programme ownership at L3 and beyond.

How You'll Make Impact

Governance, Risk and Compliance

- Support workstreams within Checkout's GRC programme, including ISO 27001, SOC 2, PCI DSS, and applicable regulatory obligations across our global licensed entities.

- Assist with control evidence collection activities, coordinating with internal teams to gather accurate and timely evidence in support of audit readiness.

- Maintain GRC documentation including policies, standards, procedures, and control matrices under the guidance of senior colleagues.

- Support monitoring of the risk register, tracking remediation activity against agreed timelines and escalating where commitments are at risk.

- Assist in conducting third-party risk assessments, evaluating supplier security controls in line with Checkout's TPRM framework.

- Develop working knowledge of regulatory obligations across Checkout's operating markets, including FCA/PRA requirements, payment scheme rules, and DORA.

AI Governance

- Support the operationalisation of Checkout's AI governance framework, aligned to ISO 42001, the EU AI Act, and NIST AI RMF.

- Assist in conducting AI risk assessments for internal AI and ML systems and third-party AI tools, under the guidance of more senior analysts.

- Help maintain an inventory of AI use cases and associated risk classifications, working with product and engineering teams as directed.

- Develop awareness of the evolving regulatory landscape for AI in financial services and contribute to policy and control documentation.

- Contribute to the development and communication of responsible AI usage guidance for staff, helping teams across the business understand acceptable use boundaries, data handling expectations, and the risks associated with AI tools in a regulated environment.

Application Security

- Contribute to Checkout's application security programme, including support for secure code review processes, SDLC integration, and developer security guidance.

- Support threat modelling activities for new and existing products, identifying security requirements under the guidance of senior colleagues.

- Assist in managing vulnerability findings from penetration tests, bug bounty programmes, and automated tooling, tracking remediation and validating fixes.

- Apply knowledge of the OWASP Top 10 and secure development frameworks to practical security reviews and guidance activities.

Technology Risk

- Support technology risk assessments across infrastructure, cloud environments, and third-party systems, contributing to outputs with actionable treatment recommendations.

- Assist with control assurance activities including vulnerability scanning coordination, access control assessments, and firewall and configuration reviews.

- Develop an understanding of Checkout's technology risk landscape, identifying emerging threats and contributing inputs to the risk register.

- Support DORA-related ICT risk management activities under the direction of senior analysts.

Data Governance

- Support Checkout's data governance programme, including data classification activities, data flow mapping, and enforcement of data handling standards.

- Assist with data loss prevention (DLP) controls and tooling, contributing to activities that ensure sensitive data is protected throughout its lifecycle.

- Help maintain records of processing activities (RoPA) and support data protection impact assessments (DPIAs) for new systems.

- Develop working knowledge of GDPR, UK GDPR, and applicable regional data protection requirements as they affect Checkout's operations.

Cross-domain Collaboration

- Work with Engineering, Product, Legal, Procurement, Finance, and Compliance teams to support the embedding of security requirements into processes, systems, and projects.

- Respond to security due diligence requests from merchants, partners, and regulators with accuracy and within agreed SLAs, escalating complex queries appropriately.

- Communicate clearly with internal stakeholders on security requirements, keeping teams updated on changes and project progress.

- Contribute to security awareness initiatives, promoting a security-conscious culture across Checkout.

What We're Looking for

Experience

- 1 to 2 years of experience in information security, IT audit, or a closely related function, ideally within payments, financial services, or fintech.

- Working knowledge of at least one of the following domains: GRC, AppSec, technology risk, or data governance.

- Practical familiarity with at least one compliance framework: PCI DSS, ISO 27001, SOC 2, NIST CSF, or equivalent.

- Some exposure to external audits, risk assessments, or security assurance activities.

- Ability to manage tasks independently and deliver on commitments reliably.

Skills and Approach

- Clear written and verbal communication. You can translate security concepts for technical and non-technical audiences.

- Detail-oriented and methodical. You approach your work carefully and follow through consistently.

- Curious and proactive. You ask questions, flag issues early, and look for root causes rather than surface fixes.

- Collaborative and adaptable. You work effectively across teams and adjust your approach as priorities shift.

- Receptive to feedback and committed to developing your information security skills across multiple domains.

Preferred

- Pursuing or holding a relevant certification: CompTIA Security+, CISA (in progress), ISO 27001 Foundation, or equivalent.

- Familiarity with cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP) from a security or compliance perspective.

- Exposure to security or GRC tooling such as Wiz, Qualys, Microsoft Sentinel, ServiceNow GRC, or similar.

- Awareness of AI governance frameworks or the OWASP LLM Top 10.

- Some scripting or automation experience (Python, etc.) is a plus.

title: Senior Information Security Analyst (GRC)
description:
Company Description

We’re . You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day.


We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers.

Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale.

If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact.

With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.

The Role

As a Senior Information Security Analyst within the GRC team, you will lead the strategic and technical execution of 's governance, risk and compliance programme. This is a role for a seasoned GRC professional who brings deep expertise across regulatory compliance, enterprise risk management, and security governance — and who can operate with full autonomy while shaping how the function evolves.

You will take ownership of Checkout's most complex and high-stakes compliance programmes — PCI DSS v4.0.1, ISO 27001, SOC 2, DORA, and emerging obligations across our global licensed entities — while providing expert guidance to engineering, product, legal, and compliance teams on the security requirements that underpin our ability to operate and grow in regulated markets worldwide.

At L4, you are a trusted advisor. You do not just manage compliance — you set the direction for it. You define how risk is identified, assessed, and treated. You advise on product and infrastructure decisions from a risk perspective. You mentor and develop junior and mid-level analysts. And you work closely with security leadership to ensure the GRC programme is aligned to the business's strategic objectives and risk appetite.

Your influence extends well beyond the GRC team. You help shape the security culture at Checkout, driving a risk-aware mindset across the business through clear communication, pragmatic guidance, and expert leadership.

How You'll Make An Impact

GRC Programme Leadership

- Lead defined sub-areas of Checkout's GRC programme end-to-end, including PCI DSS v4.0.1, ISO 27001, SOC 2, and regulatory obligations across Europe, MENA, APAC, and the Americas.

- Define how control evidence is collected and maintained, moving the function toward continuous audit readiness and away from point-in-time preparation.

- Own and drive improvements to GRC documentation including policies, standards, procedures, and control matrices — ensuring they reflect Checkout's evolving risk profile and regulatory obligations.

- Lead gap analyses against new and evolving requirements, including DORA ICT risk obligations and the EU AI Act, producing prioritised remediation roadmaps with clear business impact framing.

- Own the risk register for your sub-area, managing risk treatment through to closure and escalating to leadership where risk appetite may be exceeded.

- Define and refine Checkout's third-party risk management approach for high-risk and critical vendors, setting assessment standards and overseeing their consistent application.

- Drive continual improvement of the GRC programme itself — regularly assessing programme maturity, identifying process inefficiencies, and implementing improvements to how risk is identified, assessed, treated, and reported across the business.

Audit and Assessment Leadership

- Serve as the primary point of contact for external auditors, QSAs, and regulatory assessors across PCI DSS, ISO 27001, SOC 2, and ITGC audit cycles.

- Demonstrated experience implementing ISO management system standards end-to-end, covering initial scoping and gap assessment through control design, policy development, internal audit programme, and certification – ideally across more than one standard.

- Lead end-to-end audit delivery — scoping, evidence preparation, walkthrough facilitation, finding management, and formal closure.

- Own the end-to-end response process for complex merchant assurance and regulatory due diligence requests, ensuring Checkout's compliance posture is presented accurately and persuasively.

- Lead quarterly and annual compliance activities including vulnerability scanning coordination, penetration testing programmes, access reviews, and firewall configuration assurance.

Policy, Controls and Regulatory Strategy

- Apply expert knowledge of PCI DSS v4.0.1, ISO 27001/27002, SOC 2, DORA, NIST CSF, and related frameworks to drive control design, policy development, and compliance strategy.

- Advise product and engineering teams on compliance requirements at the point of design, embedding regulatory obligations into architecture decisions and development workflows.

- Lead Checkout's regulatory change management activities — monitoring the evolving landscape across financial services, data protection, and AI regulation, assessing business impact, and driving remediation programmes.

- Identify and drive systemic improvements to GRC processes, including automation opportunities that improve programme efficiency and evidence quality.

- Contribute to the design and development of GRC tooling, dashboards, and risk reporting to improve leadership visibility of Checkout's compliance and risk posture.

Stakeholder Influence and Team Development

- Act as a senior trusted advisor to Engineering, Product, Legal, Finance, Procurement, and Compliance on all GRC matters, communicating risk in business terms that drive informed decisions.

- Represent the GRC function in cross-functional forums, governance committees, and regulatory discussions, influencing decisions that affect Checkout's risk posture.

- Mentor and develop junior and mid-level GRC analysts (L1–L3), raising the capability of the team through structured knowledge sharing, review, and coaching.

- Promote a security-first culture across Checkout through proactive engagement, executive-level reporting, and accessible guidance that empowers non-security teams to make good risk decisions.

What We're Looking For:

Experience

- 5 or more years of experience in GRC, information security compliance, IT audit, or a closely related function, ideally within payments, financial services, or fintech.

- Deep working knowledge of PCI DSS (v4.0.1 required), ISO 27001, and SOC 2. Practical experience with DORA, NIST CSF, the EU AI Act, or FCA/PRA obligations is strongly preferred.

- Demonstrated track record of leading external audits and regulatory assessments end-to-end, including managing assessor relationships and driving findings to closure.

- Proven ability to own and deliver complex GRC programme workstreams independently, including gap analyses, risk treatment programmes, and regulatory change initiatives.

- Experience advising engineering and product teams on compliance requirements, with the ability to translate regulatory obligations into practical, proportionate controls.

- Track record of developing and mentoring less experienced colleagues.

Skills and Approach

- Expert written and verbal communication. You can frame complex regulatory and risk issues for a technical audience, a business stakeholder, and executive leadership — and adapt your style to drive the right outcome in each context.

- Strategic and analytical thinker. You see beyond individual findings and controls to understand systemic risk patterns, root causes, and the broader implications for the business.

- Decisive under ambiguity. You can set direction and make sound judgement calls on prioritisation and risk treatment without waiting for perfect information.

description:

Join us in lowering the cost of access to space, fulfilling Blue Origin's vision of millions living and working in space to benefit Earth.

As part of our Enterprise Technology (ET) team, you'll help develop the digital infrastructure essential for building the road to space. This is a platform engineering roleâ€”you'll be building the thing that builds the thing.

Join our dynamic team as a Senior Front-End Engineer building an AI-powered UI platform that connects data to user-defined composable UIs. You'll work with an AI-first mentality with guardrails, creating the foundation that enables engineers, designers, and product managers across Blue Origin to build interfaces faster and more consistently.

What You'll Work With

Key Responsibilities

Platform Architecture & Development

Design System Engineering

  • Implement contract enforcement mechanisms that validate generated UIs against component library standards
  • Create tooling that enables design system changes to propagate efficiently across applications
  • Bridge the gap between design tools and executable code

Technical Leadership & Governance

  • Define and maintain technical standards, contracts, and schemas that developers will build against
  • Establish performance budgets, accessibility requirements, and quality gates for platform-generated code
  • Lead architectural decisions for multi-runtime support with shared abstractions

Collaboration & Enablement

  • Partner closely with designers, AI/ML engineers, backend developers, and product teams

  • Work with product managers to translate customer needs into platform capabilities
  • Provide thought leadership on AI-assisted development and design system governance

Innovation & Evolution

  • Stay at the forefront of AI-assisted development and declarative UI frameworks
  • Prototype and evaluate new technologies that could enhance platform capabilities
  • Drive continuous improvement based on usage telemetry and developer feedback

Required Qualifications

  • 7+ years of front-end development experience, with substantial time shipping production software to real users
  • Expert-level mastery of HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and TypeScript
  • Deep experience with React (required) and React Native (strongly preferred), including component architecture, state management, and performance optimization
  • Platform/tooling development experience: You've built tools, frameworks, or platforms that other engineers use
  • Strong systems thinking: Ability to design abstractions, contracts, and APIs that balance flexibility with governance
  • GraphQL expertise: Designing, consuming, and integrating GraphQL APIs
  • Production mindset: Experience with CI/CD pipelines, testing strategies, monitoring, and operational excellence
  • Responsive design mastery: Deep understanding of adaptive layouts and cross-device compatibility
  • Accessibility champion: Working knowledge of WCAG guidelines and inclusive design practices
  • Git proficiency: Advanced source control management and code review best practices
  • Mentorship experience: Track record of guiding engineers through architecture decisions and technical growth

Desired Qualifications

  • Design system experience: Prior work building or maintaining component libraries at scale
  • AI/LLM integration experience: Working with generative AI APIs, prompt engineering, or AI-assisted development tools
  • Compiler/parser knowledge: Experience with ASTs, code generation, or DSL implementation
  • Multi-platform development: Experience building abstractions that work across web and native mobile
  • Backend technology exposure: Familiarity with Node.js, AWS services, or containerization
  • Build tooling expertise: Deep knowledge of Webpack, Vite, or similar build systems
  • Performance profiling: Experience with optimization techniques and debugging tools
  • Strong communication skills: Ability to translate complex technical concepts for variety of audiences
  • Product mindset: Experience working closely with designers and PMs to shape product direction

What Success Looks Like

In your first 6-12 months, you will:

  • Architect core platform capabilities that enable the generation of production-ready UIs
  • Establish governance frameworks ensuring generated code meets quality, performance, and accessibility standards
  • Enable measurable impact: Contribute to accelerating UI development across the organization
  • Drive adoption: Help teams transition to platform-generated interfaces
  • Build for scale: Design systems that handle hundreds of applications
  • Mentor and elevate: Raise the technical bar through code reviews, design discussions, and knowledge sharing

Why Join This Team

This is an opportunity to:

  • Work on a platform that will transform how an aerospace company builds software
  • Combine cutting-edge AI with production engineering at scale
  • Define the future of UI development for mission-critical applications
  • Join a team that values innovation, quality, and empowering developers

If you\'re passionate about building platforms that empower others, thrive on complex technical challenges, and want to make a lasting impact on how software is created, we want you on our team.

Apply today to help build the thing that builds the thing at Blue Origin!

  • Act as a senior creative voice in collaboration with marketing, product, and external partners, shaping 360° campaigns from strategy through execution

  • Contribute to and help govern the design system in Figma as a strategic asset, weighing in on architecture, scalability, and adoption decisions with other senior designers

  • Help set direction for motion and micro-interaction standards (After Effects, Jitter, Rive), and mentor others building this craft across the team

  • Shape how AI tools are used across the creative process — building and championing workflows that spread adoption team-wide rather than staying siloed with one person

You'll need the following experience and qualifications to succeed in this role:

  • Seasoned experience across in-house teams, studios, or agencies, with a track record of senior creative ownership

  • A portfolio demonstrating not just high-quality brand work, but the ability to help set direction and raise craft across a team

title: Senior Software Engineer, Technical Leadership / Platform (Remote)
description:
Role Overview

This is a Senior Software Engineer role with a Technical Leadership / Platform specialization, focused on system design, reliability, and long-term platform evolution. You will help the team understand how our systems should behave under load, during failures, and as they scale, ensuring the platform foundation remains healthy over time. The role involves a significant architectural focus (30-50%) while remaining fully hands-on: you take ownership of the most complex or high-risk backend work, and act as the technical representative for API/SDK integrations with third-party vendors and clients, during and after the integration.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and evolve core platform services, focusing on reliability, data integrity, and clear service boundaries aligned with business requirements
  • Identify architectural risks, scalability limits, and weak points before they become production issues; recognize when existing tools (queues, storage, frameworks) reach their limits and propose pragmatic, incremental improvement or migration paths
  • Own the technical relationship with partners as the primary technical point of contact: lead solution reviews, troubleshooting, and roadmap alignment; document technical decisions and integration details; ensure partners understand expectations, timelines, and constraints
  • Design and improve reliability mechanisms: retries and backoff, timeouts and idempotency, handling of partial failures, degraded and fallback modes
  • Drive improvements in observability (metrics, logs, tracing, operational visibility) and participate in production incident analysis
  • Contribute during the Discovery stage of projects: build PoCs, validate ideas, analyze third-party vendor APIs and proposed integration flows
  • Implement the most complex and high-risk backend components using TypeScript and Node.js, owning correctness under partial failure scenarios
  • Raise the overall technical maturity of the team, including senior engineers: thoughtful code reviews, decomposition of large or ambiguous problems, knowledge sharing through pairing and documentation

Required Qualifications

  • 6+ years of professional backend development experience
  • Deep hands-on experience building and operating crypto infrastructure: custody, wallets, exchange, payment, or settlement systems. You have designed and run production systems that move real funds. Integrating a crypto API into an existing product, or building UI on top of one, does not meet this bar
  • Strong backend expertise in TypeScript and Node.js
  • Deep experience in distributed system design: microservices architecture, service boundaries and data models, REST APIs and API contracts, queues and asynchronous communication
  • Hands-on production experience: incident response, debugging, API failures, data issues
  • Experience owning services end-to-end, from design to production support
  • Excellent knowledge of SQL (PostgreSQL) and understanding of other storage types
  • Strong reliability mindset and experience with failure scenarios; experience improving observability and investigating production incidents
  • Proficient daily use of AI coding tools (e.g. Claude Code, Copilot), with the ability to review AI-generated code quickly and critically
  • Ability to mentor engineers, including senior-level, and to evaluate trade-offs and propose practical solutions
  • High agency: you treat problems in your scope as yours by default, act before being asked, and escalate with a proposed plan when a decision is above your level
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to bridge technical and business conversations; strong written and verbal English

Preferred Experience

  • Experience leading architecture work across timezones in a distributed team
  • Experience in regulated financial environments (licensing, audits, compliance-driven engineering requirements)
  • Experience with queues and event-driven systems (Kafka, RabbitMQ, SQS, etc.)
  • Redis or other in-memory data stores
  • Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, and AWS (user-level understanding)
  • Experience shaping team practices around AI-assisted development

Reporting Structure

Reports to the Engineering Manager. This role does not include direct people management, only technical influence.

Why This Role

  • Own the technical foundation of a crypto payment platform being built now: architecture decisions you make will define the platform for years
  • Full technical ownership of the highest-risk, highest-impact work in the company, with direct influence on how the whole engineering organization builds
  • AI-first engineering culture where your leverage multiplies through the team

Location

Remote. USA, Argentina, or Brazil. The role works US business hours (Eastern Time). A minimum of 4 hours of daily overlap with Central European working hours is a requirement.

Compensation and Benefits

As an independent contractor, you'll enjoy the flexibility to determine how and when you deliver your work, while partnering closely with our team to meet agreed milestones and business objectives. Compensation and engagement terms will be outlined in your contractor agreement.

Additional Benefits

  • Company issued laptop
  • Technology Accessories
  • Annual In-Person Full-Team Meetup

About Cyclops

Cyclops enables payments companies to onboard with a single partner, unlocking stablecoin settlement, payins, payouts and treasury optimization across global corridors – all through a single API.

Cyclops was founded by payments executives and crypto veterans who were fed up with stablecoin fragmentation. The first complete stablecoin platform built exclusively for the payments industry, Cyclops combines the agility of orchestration with the comprehensive build outs of full-stack providers. title: Top of Funnel Tooling Product Owner (f/m/d)
description:
At Moss, we give finance professionals the power to automate their day-to-day and make forward-thinking decisions.

Our team and culture make us unique — we’re driven by impact and growth, where every one of us strives to learn and excel. Recognised by Sifted’s Rising 100 and LinkedIn's Top Startups, we’re here to help propel your career and together, make Moss a lasting success.

This role owns Moss's top of funnel tooling stack: HubSpot, the Salesforce lead and campaign layer, and Attention. Much of this stack was built without deep Salesforce expertise, so you will start by diagnosing where lead routing and attribution genuinely break down, then rebuild it into something best in class, including AI driven routing and dynamic nurture.

You will set the roadmap for this domain within Commercial Systems, working closely with Growth, BDR and SDR teams whose pipeline quality depends on the decisions you make, and partnering closely with the Head of GTM Automation. You will report to the Director of Commercial Systems, with weekly check ins against cycle goals rather than close oversight, and no direct reports of your own.

Your responsibilities

  • Own and administer the marketing automation stack, currently HubSpot, to support campaign management and email marketing as the backbone of Moss's top of funnel motion

  • Design and maintain the tooling that supports the handoff between multi-channel lead flows across marketing, product and sales into Salesforce, including tools such as Sweep, Calendly and n8n, to ensure the critical lead infrastructure supports the SLAs that BDR and SDR teams work to

  • Administer Salesforce's Lead, Contact and campaign influence layer, diagnosing and fixing gaps in the current routing setup

  • Partner with Growth, BDR, SDR and Partnerships to translate their requirements into system changes, working closely with the Head of GTM Automation's team

  • Run sales productivity tooling such as Attention, including onboarding and offboarding commercial users

  • Monitor system performance, resolve bugs and ship fixes in partnership with engineering

  • Act as the internal and vendor facing subject matter expert for top of funnel tooling, experimenting to keep the stack best in class

About you

  • 4+ years' experience administering a marketing automation platform (HubSpot or equivalent) and Salesforce, including lead routing and lifecycle management, in a B2B SaaS context

  • Salesforce Certified Administrator

  • Experience with AI productivity tooling such as n8n and Attention

  • Fluent English (native or C2)

  • Experience with lead routing or lifecycle management tooling such as LeanData, RingLead or Chili Piper is a plus

  • Experience working with APIs and engineering teams is a plus

In addition, here are the skills and attributes we are looking for:

  • Takes time to understand the problem with business stakeholders before proposing a solution

  • Delivers change consistently, with a track record of measurable impact rather than one-off wins

  • Comfortable diagnosing messy, undocumented systems and defining the target state yourself, rather than working from a pre-defined spec

  • Willing to experiment and test new approaches to keep the stack ahead of what's standard

  • Designs and builds AI-powered workflows or tools in production, with clear evidence of real-world usage and impact

About Moss

Moss is a SaaS scale-up founded in Berlin, with a team of 300+ people from 50+ nationalities in 5 offices across Europe.

Our ambition is bold: to power every SMB’s spend across Europe - fully digital, AI-driven, and seamlessly integrated for complete control. To date, over 5000 businesses in Germany, Netherlands and the UK use Moss’ leading spend management product, with modules such as corporate cards, accounts payables, employee cash reimbursements and procurement.

Moss has raised a total of €180 million in funding and is backed by the most renowned tech investors including Valar Ventures, Tiger Global, Global Founders Capital, Cherry Ventures and A-Star.

Be part of a culture that thrives on impact and speed, where you can take bold moves, learn fast and accomplish more. We’re a place where you can fast track your career - here's what else to expect:

  • Top-of-market compensation package, including equity.

  • Our vibrant offices are at the heart of our culture, where in-person time fuels collaboration and connection over weekly breakfasts and Friday demos.

  • Additional benefits include: 20 days “work from abroad”, 600EUR/GBP Learning & Development Budget, and other local benefits.

Unless stated otherwise, benefits apply to full-time positions (interns and working students receive a tailored package).

By applying for the above position, you will confirm that you have reviewed and agreed to our Data Privacy Policy.

title: Director of Algorithms Development
description:
QuantHealth - Who We Are?
QuantHealth is a growing AI startup in the clinical trial space, leveraging AI, biomedical data, knowledge graphs, and real-world patient data to simulate and optimize clinical trials for pharmaceutical companies.
Our platform helps customers simulate clinical trials, reduce development risk and cost, shorten timelines, and improve the probability of clinical trial success.

About the Role
QuantHealth’s core technology is built around simulation, prediction, and AI-driven clinical trial optimization. We develop machine learning systems that model patient outcomes, treatment effects, enrollment dynamics, and clinical trial success, leveraging large-scale real-world healthcare data, biomedical knowledge, and advanced machine learning techniques.

We are looking for a Director of AI & Algorithms to lead the team responsible for developing the models and methodologies that power these capabilities.

You will lead a team of researchers, data scientists, and algorithm developers working on clinical trial simulation, predictive modeling, foundation models, uncertainty quantification, and next-generation AI capabilities. You will be responsible for setting scientific direction, guiding major modeling decisions, establishing validation methodologies, and ensuring that QuantHealth continues to advance the state of the art in AI-driven clinical development.

This role combines scientific leadership, people leadership, and technical depth. The ideal candidate has experience building and leading high-performing AI teams, developing machine learning products in production environments, and translating scientific innovation into measurable business impact.

What Will You Do as Part of The Role?

  • Lead and grow the AI & Algorithms team, including researchers, data scientists, and algorithm developers.
  • Define the scientific and algorithmic roadmap for QuantHealth’s simulation, prediction, and AI platforms.
  • Guide the development of foundation models, predictive models, simulation methodologies, and future AI-driven product capabilities.
  • Establish validation methodologies, benchmarking standards, uncertainty quantification approaches, and model calibration strategies.
  • Partner closely with Clinical Informatics, DataOps, MLOps, Product, and Engineering teams to translate scientific challenges into scalable solutions.
  • Drive the evaluation and adoption of new machine learning methods, data representations, and modeling approaches.
  • Review and guide major modeling, statistical, and methodological decisions across the organization.
  • Own scientific publications, conference submissions, and external research collaborations related to QuantHealth’s core algorithms and simulation technologies.
  • Represent QuantHealth’s scientific capabilities to customers, partners, investors, and the broader AI and healthcare communities.
  • Mentor and develop senior technical talent while helping build a culture of scientific rigor, innovation, and execution.

What does it require from you?

  • Experience leading machine learning, AI, or applied research teams in production environments.
  • Strong background in machine learning, statistics, predictive modeling, or related quantitative disciplines, both in industry and academia.
  • Experience developing, evaluating, and deploying machine learning systems that drive real-world products or business outcomes.
  • Strong understanding of model validation, experimental design, uncertainty quantification, and statistical evaluation methodologies.
  • Experience translating ambiguous scientific or business problems into practical modeling solutions.
  • Track record of recruiting, mentoring, and developing high-performing technical teams.
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to collaborate across scientific, technical, and business functions.
  • Ability to balance long-term scientific innovation with short-term product and business needs.

Strong Advantages

  • Experience developing foundation models, large-scale machine learning systems, or AI-first products.
  • Experience working with healthcare, life sciences, biomedical, or real-world patient data.
  • Track record of scientific publications, conference presentations, or external thought leadership.
  • Experience developing simulation systems, causal inference methodologies, time-to-event models, or advanced predictive modeling systems.
  • Experience in high-growth startup environments where both technical leadership and execution are required.

Notes

  • At QuantHealth, we believe in creating an inclusive and diverse work environment where everyone can thrive and contribute to our shared goals. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and experiences.
  • We mix remote and in-office work. Most of the team is in the office two days a week and works from home the remaining days.

ABOUT WFP

The World Food Programme is the world’s largest humanitarian organization saving lives in emergencies and using food assistance to build a pathway to peace, stability and prosperity, for people recovering from conflict, disasters and the impact of climate change.


At WFP, people are at the heart of everything we do and the vision of the future WFP workforce is one of diverse, committed, skilled, and high performing teams, selected on merit, operating in a healthy and inclusive work environment, living WFP's values (Integrity, Collaboration, Commitment, Humanity, and Inclusion) and working with partners to save and change the lives of those WFP serves.

To learn more about WFP, visit our website: and follow us on social media to keep up with our latest news: YouTube, LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, Twitter, TikTok.

WHY JOIN WFP?

  • WFP is a 2020 Nobel Peace Prize Laureate.

  • WFP offers a highly inclusive, diverse, and multicultural working environment.

  • WFP invests in the personal & professional development of its employees through a range of training, accreditation, coaching, mentorship, and other programs as well as through internal mobility opportunities.

  • A career path in WFP provides an exciting opportunity to work across the various country, regional and global offices around the world, and with passionate colleagues who work tirelessly to ensure that effective humanitarian assistance reaches millions of people across the globe.

  • We offer an attractive compensation package (please refer to the Terms and Conditions section of this vacancy announcement).

To contribute to daily management of WFP’s security operations to facilitate the effective delivery of programmes that meet food assistance needs and maintain the security and safety of WFP personnel, activities and facilities.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES (not all-inclusive, within delegated authority):

1. Contribute to security and safety contingency and business continuity plans for the office by supporting the standardization, implementation, and testing of emergency response systems across WFP facilities in-country.
2. Liaise with the United Nations Department of Safety and Security (UNDSS) and the in-country security management system and participate in security operations and management meetings to ensure WFP management and staff are fully informed and briefed on security developments affecting the Country Office (CO) and Field Offices.
3. Support Country, Area, and Field Offices in achieving and maintaining compliance with Security Risk Management Measures, in coordination with WFP’s Security Division.
4. Oversee facility access control measures and procedures to ensure the safety and security of WFP personnel, visitors, and assets, in line with UNSMS and best practices.
5. Contribute the management of security budgets and procurement planning to ensure the efficient, effective, and cost-conscious utilization of security resources.
6. Responsible for management of security equipment ensuring they are properly issued, in serviceable condition, and compliant with established security standards.
7. Coordinate with the Human Resources Unit on security staffing matters (recruitment, contract management, capacity-building), ensuring compliance with WFP policies and procedures.
8. Monitor and analyze local security developments and emerging risks, assessing their potential impact on WFP and CP personnel, assets, and operations, and providing timely updates to the supervisor.
9. Prepare and submit accurate, comprehensive, and timely security reports, including near miss and contextually relevant political and security developments in the WFP Security Incident Report platform – STARS, and provide briefings to support informed decision-making and ensure consistency in information provided to senior management.
10. Conduct security orientation briefings for newly arrived personnel, ensuring they are fully aware of local security conditions, risks, procedures, and emergency protocols.
11. Support the planning and delivery of security training and awareness activities to strengthen the security preparedness and capabilities of WFP personnel and external partners.
12. Provide operational security support during emergencies and crisis situations, assisting the supervisor in responding to evolving requirements and emerging threats.
13. Perform other security-related duties and responsibilities as assigned by the supervisor in support of WFP operations and organizational objectives.

QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE:

Education: Completion of Advanced University Degree (Master’s or equivalent) is required. Education in Security Management, International Relations or Law Enforcement or other field relevant to security, political science, humanitarian and international development.

Experience: At least 5 years of overall experience, including 3 years of Professional Experience (managerial or supervisory) in areas related to security management (relevant military, policy or corporate) and/or security risk management, with a background and interest in international humanitarian development. Within these 3 years of professional experience, a minimum of 1 year of experience must be after postgraduation.

Language: Fluency in spoken and written both in English and Bangla language.

The position also supports documentation, reporting, SOP administration, and continuous improvement initiatives to strengthen service efficiency and operational excellence.

Operational Support:

  • Manage and support SOP administration, documentation, periodic review, and updates to ensure operational processes remain current, compliant, and aligned with business and policy requirements.

  • Monitor operational processes, identify workflow gaps, risks, or inefficiencies, and proactively escalate improvement opportunities to relevant stakeholders including Regulatory Affairs, Sales, Marketing, Account Management, Compliance, Finance, Supply Chain, and other functions.

  • Coordinate with Sales Team, Finance, and regional Sales Force Effectiveness subject matter experts to support implementation, administration, performance tracking, monitoring, and reporting of sales force effectiveness systems and related business tools.

  • Support adoption and administration of standard systems, tools, and service channels to improve operational efficiency, data quality, user compliance, and consistency of execution.

  • Prepare, consolidate, and maintain operational reports, trackers, dashboards, and documentation required for leadership reviews, business monitoring, project updates, and decision-making.

  • Coordinate cross-functional communication, meeting follow-ups, action tracking, and operational issue resolution to ensure timely delivery of business requirements and service commitments.

  • Maintain strong attention to accuracy, compliance, confidentiality, and continuous improvement in all operational activities and stakeholder interactions.

Project Management

  • Support monitoring and tracking of key projects and priorities to ensure delivery and outcomes are achieved

  • Bringing external best practice and perspectives into the organization

  • Act as Animal health culture engagement champion to actively involve in cross function activities (HH & AH)

Customer Service support:

  • Respond to customer enquiries related to products, services, order status, delivery, billing, and company processes in a timely, accurate, and professional manner.

  • Handle customer complaints and service issues with active listening, empathy, and ownership; coordinate with relevant internal teams to investigate root causes, provide solutions, and ensure proper follow-up until closure.

  • Process and coordinate customer transactions including order placement, billing support, payment documentation, invoices, purchase orders, returns, and related administrative requirements with accuracy and compliance.

  • Maintain complete and accurate customer interaction records, complaints, actions taken, and follow-up status in the relevant CRM, tracking system, or internal documentation platform.

  • Collaborate closely with Sales, Supply Chain, Finance, Regulatory Affairs, Marketing, Technical, and other cross-functional teams to ensure seamless customer support and timely resolution of operational matters.

title: Cyber Security Engineer
description:
Company Description

We’re . You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day.


We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers.

Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale.

If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact.

With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.

The role

This role will be responsible for supporting design & implementation of AI-enabled capabilities across Checkout, while ensuring AI technologies are deployed in a safe, governed, and resilient manner. The successful candidate will work closely with Engineering, Data Governance, GRC, and business teams to embed security into AI systems, assess AI-related risks, and help the organisation adopt AI securely at scale.

As a Cyber Security Engineer I, you will act as the bridge between cyber security and emerging AI technologies. You will help shape how Checkout secures AI tools, models, data pipelines, and supporting infrastructure, while also identifying opportunities to use AI to strengthen cyber defence capabilities.

This is a hands-on role suited to someone who understands modern security engineering and has a strong interest in AI/ML technologies, LLMs, automation, and risk management.

What you’ll be responsible for

  • Design and implement security controls for AI and machine learning solutions, including LLM-based applications, model integrations, and supporting cloud infrastructure.

  • Assess the security, privacy, and compliance risks associated with AI systems, including model misuse, prompt injection, data leakage, insecure plugins, over-permissioned access, and third-party AI services.

  • Develop standards, guardrails, and reference architectures for the secure use of AI across the organisation.

  • Review AI use cases, architectures, and deployments to ensure alignment with cyber security policies, regulatory requirements, and internal governance expectations.

  • Build and maintain monitoring, detection, and response capabilities for AI-related threats and misuse scenarios.

  • Identify opportunities to use AI to enhance cyber security operations, such as alert triage, threat analysis, playbook automation, knowledge retrieval, and workflow optimisation.

  • Stay current on evolving risks, attack techniques, regulations, and industry practices related to AI security and AI governance (inline with EU AI Act, ISO42001)

What we’re looking for

  • Experience in cyber security engineering, security architecture, or a related security role.

  • Strong understanding of core security domains such as identity and access management, cloud security, application security, data protection, logging and monitoring, and incident response.

  • Knowledge of AI/ML and LLM concepts, including model deployment patterns, APIs, embeddings, vector stores, prompt handling, and common AI security risks.

  • Experience securing cloud environments and modern development workflows in platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.

  • Familiarity with security risks relevant to AI systems, including prompt injection, data exfiltration, insecure model access, supply chain risks, model poisoning, and sensitive data exposure.

  • Experience conducting architecture reviews, threat modelling, and security assessments for complex technical solutions.

  • Ability to translate technical risk into clear, practical guidance for both engineering and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Strong collaboration skills and the ability to work across cyber security, engineering, data, legal, and business teams.

  • A proactive mindset, with the ability to operate in a fast-moving area where standards and best practices continue to evolve.

Additional Information

Bring all of you to work

We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one.

Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands.

We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here.

It’s important we set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter directly, if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable.

Life at

We understand that work is just one part of your life. Our hybrid working model offers flexibility, with three days per week in the office to support collaboration and connection.

title: Graver til Nordrupøster og Farendløse Kirker
description:
Nordrupøster-Farendløse Menighedsråd søger en dygtig og samarbejdsvillig graver til en fuldtidsstilling på 37 timer, med tiltrædelse hurtigst muligt.

Stillingen er tilknyttet Kirkerne og kirkegårdene i Nordrupøster og Farendløse Sogn, der må forventes fleksibilitet, da der er en samarbejdsforpligtelse med de øvrige kirker i pastoratet: Sneslev og Ørslev Kirker.

Graveren arbejder i det daglige tæt sammen med en flex-jobber, men det er også vigtigt, at man kan samarbejde med kirkens øvrige personale, da graveren har en central rolle både i det daglige arbejde på kirkegården og i forbindelse med de kirkelige handlinger.

Dine opgaver vil blandt andet omfatte:

At kirkegården og de omkringliggende arealer fremstår velholdte.

At medvirke ved kirkelige handlinger gennem klargøring før og oprydning efter (gudstjenester, begravelser, bisættelser, vielser, koncerter m.m.)

At møde og vejlede besøgende og pårørende på en respektfuld og hjælpsom måde

At planlægge og tilrettelægge det daglige arbejde på kirkegården

At varetage de administrative opgaver, som knytter sig til kirkegårdsdriften.

At sørge for drift og vedligeholdelse af maskiner og arbejdsredskaber.

At indgå i et tæt samarbejde med kirkens øvrige ansatte og menighedsrådet

At passe udearealer omkring præsteboligen.

Hvem er du:

· Du trives med selvstændigt arbejde og har en god sans for struktur og overblik

· Du kan tage ansvar og har hænderne skruet rigtigt på

· Du har interesse for - og gerne erfaring med - pleje af grønne områder

· Du møder mennesker med venlighed, respekt og situationsfornemmelse

· Du bidrager positivt til samarbejdet med kolleger, præster og menighedsråd

· Du er fleksibel og indstillet på varierende arbejdstider, herunder weekender og helligdage

· Du har respekt og forståelse for kirkens ritualer, handlinger og værdier.

· Du har forståelse for at driften af kirkegårdene skal foregå inden for den økonomiske ramme som menighedsrådet har vedtaget.

· Du har kørekort.

Ansættelse og aflønning sker efter gældende overenskomst

Årslønnen indplaceres i intervallet mellem 343.808 til 429.972 kr. med gartnerisk uddannelse og 336.00 til 413.601 uden gartnerisk uddannelse. Stillingen er indplaceret i løngruppe 2 for gravere med gartnerisk uddannelse. Det er en betingelse, at den obligatoriske uddannelse for gravere gennemføres inden for 2 år efter ansættelsens start, hvis ikke denne er gennemført tidligere.

Der er rådighedsforpligtelse til stillingen.

Der må forventes arbejde på søn- og helligdage samt eventuelt vikararbejde i pastoratets øvrige kirker efter nærmere aftale.

Kan du se dig selv i dette, så tilbyder vi en arbejdsplads med gode og venlige kollegaer, samt et arbejde der foregår under den åbne himmel, og med en høj grad af frihed under ansvar.

Mulighed for at deltage i relevante kurser for at kunne varetage opgaverne bedst muligt.

Yderligere oplysninger kan fås ved henvendelse til kontaktperson Jacob Broholm Møller på tlf. 29746214 eller til menighedsrådsformand Jesper Mørch Idziak på tlf. 60669922.

Ansøgning med CV sendes til Nordrupøster-Farendløse Menighedsråd på mail: 7371Fortrolig@sogn.dk

Ansøgningsfrist: søndag d. 23 August. Vi forventer at holde samtaler fredag d. 28. August.

title: Senior Developer
description:
Integration meets Innovation

At Celigo, we believe integration should empower — not exhaust — innovation. As a modern Integration and Automation Platform (iPaaS), we’re on a mission to simplify how companies integrate, automate, and optimize processes. Powered by game-changing technology like runtime AI and prebuilt, mission-critical integrations, Celigo is redefining how businesses connect their world.

The Professional Services Senior Developer is responsible for designing and delivering scalable integration solutions using the Celigo integrator.io platform. This role focuses on implementing and optimizing integrations between ERP systems (such as NetSuite, SAP, or Microsoft Dynamics) and modern cloud-based applications (such as Amazon, Shopify, Salesforce, and HubSpot), while leveraging emerging capabilities like Celigo agentic services and MCP servers to enable intelligent automation and orchestration. The ideal candidate brings deep technical expertise, a consultative mindset, and a passion for building resilient, high-performing integration architectures.

What would you do if hired?

  • Utilize Celigo’s AI capabilities — including AI Studio, agentic workflows, and MCP server orchestration

  • Deploy and manage Celigo agentic services for intelligent automation use cases
  • Mentor junior developers and contribute to solution design reviews
  • Train customers on the use of Celigo’s integration platform
Who are we looking for?

Skills & Abilities

  • Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to troubleshoot complex integration issues
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills across technical and non-technical audiences
  • Client-facing professionalism with the ability to lead discussions, training, and advisory sessions
  • Self-starter with strong ownership, attention to detail, and ability to work independently

  • Drive to self-learn and showcase emerging technologies, including AI and automation, to elevate the practice

Technical Skills

  • Proficiency in JavaScript for scripting (hooks, transformations, custom logic)

  • Understanding of middleware and iPaaS architecture patterns
  • Experience integrating and operationalizing AI/LLM services
  • Familiarity with agentic architectures and orchestration concepts (e.g., Celigo agentic services, MCP servers)

Education & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field
  • 7+ years of experience as an Integration Developer or in a similar role
  • Experience in consulting or professional services environments with direct client engagement
  • Proven ability to design and deliver scalable, production-grade integration solutions
  • Experience across the full delivery lifecycle (requirements through post-go-live support)
  • Experience with technologies such as Node.js, web services (SOAP/REST), and data transport formats (JSON, XML, EDI, flat files)
  • Familiarity with enterprise applications (NetSuite, Salesforce, Amazon, Google, Shopify, HubSpot, etc.)
  • Strong database fundamentals (SQL, data modeling, querying)
  • Experience with AI-enabled integration patterns (LLMs, agentic services, MCP servers)
